Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) mission is to provide tools, resources, and environments that support safe, efficient, and healthy behaviors and encourage employees to proactively manage their health and wellbeing. To support this focus area, Amazon is seeking a leader to serve as our Program Manager for Worldwide WHS to build programs that create a safe workplace and build a world-class safety culture. In this role, you will dive deep into operations processes; identify risks through data and first-hand experience; build programs and improve processes to eliminate risks; and influence operations to sustain a culture of safety. This role will focus on leading large, strategic projects within Amazon Business Units (BU) and across different geographies – the role will also look for ways to replicate these BU-specific solutions to other BU, and find commonalities to support scale and speed.
The Sr. Program manager role will challenge you to push boundaries and lead transformative innovation while having the autonomy to make rapid data-driven decisions and invent on behalf of Operators (leaders) and Associates. In this role, you will work cross-functionally with members from various teams, including Operations; Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT); Amazon Robotics (AR); Inbound Supply Chain; Launch; Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP); Capacity Planning; Finance and others to deploy solutions at scale.

This position requires travel up to approximately 25% when needed (and with appropriate health and safety conditions).



Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate:
- Owns and drives safety programs from inception through global implementation, delivering measurable injury and risk reduction outcomes across Amazon's worldwide network.
- Leads and manages safety-related projects end-to-end, defining clear actions, owners, and timelines to ensure successful delivery.
- Authors narrative papers and business reviews for senior leadership audiences, clearly communicating safety priorities, program performance, and investment recommendations
- Serves as a trusted safety partner to regional leaders, aligning on strategic priorities and tracking progress against goals
- Conducts regular site visits to fulfillment centers, sortation facilities, and delivery stations to personally observe safety practices, gather front-line feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement
- Leads comprehensive incident investigations, rapidly identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions to prevent recurrence and share learnings globally
- Collaborates cross-functionally with teams in Operations, Engineering, HR, and beyond to scale successful safety initiatives and embed sustainable improvements
- Monitors safety metrics, analyze trends, and present data-driven recommendations to senior leadership on priorities and investment areas


A day in the life
As a Program Manager on the WHS Central Programs Team (CPT), your day centers on project management best practices applied to safety. Expect to spend your time reviewing safety data, running working sessions to unblock in-flight projects, and walking through operational processes to ground your decisions in field truth. You will drive projects that move from idea to validated, network-wide deployment, by working closely with BU stakeholders across the globe.

About the team
The WHS Central Programs Team (CPT) delivers projects that directly impact associate safety. This team dives deep into operational processes, leverages data to identify risks, initiates project ideas, and enhances existing processes. Collaborating closely with field operations, WHS personnel, Tech teams, engineering teams and additional stakeholders, the Central Programs Team employs project management best practices to address defined safety related issues. Furthermore, the Central Programs Team assumes direct responsibility for project definition, piloting, and the deployment of validated projects into the network.

target_jobs.description:
Reinvent how the world's largest robotics network gets deployed.
Amazon is seeking a Senior Manager for our Robotics Delivery, Packaging & Innovation to define and lead the Design for Deployment (DfD) technical deep-dive, and associated implementation strategy, across our global robotics fulfillment network. This is a founding, build-it-from-scratch role: you will define what "deployable" means for every robotics technology Amazon ships, and your decisions will shape how thousands of implementations happen across six continents.

Amazon's culture encourages an entrepreneurial approach and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems in a fast-paced environment.

The role could be based in Vercelli or alternatively in London or Luxembourg with ~60% travel across Europe and internationally for design reviews and field validation activities.

Key job responsibilities
This is a hands-on, boots-on-the-ground technical role. In the role you will:

- Serve as the organization's DfD technical authority, overview engineering drawings, mechatronic designs, and controls architectures, to embed quantified deployment requirements into engineering design, providing a single consolidated deployment voice and force multiplying deployment teams across multiple technology programs.
- Drive technically complex DfD programs: determining feasibility of infrastructure builds at scale, identifying when deployment issues stem from technical design decisions, and driving engineering to design to a defined deployment bar (mechanical, electrical, controls, layout, system integration and mechatronic domains).
- Advise VPs and the broader Robotics leadership on strategy, governance mechanisms and trade-offs, drive clarity where the problem itself may be undefined, optimize cross-organizational structures that enable teams to deliver independently.
- Coach deployment teams to engage in engineering design reviews, design decisions, and feed field learnings back to product teams systematically. You'll mentor deployment engineers and TiPMs, sharing DfD best practices and technical deep-dive methods and helping managers guide career growth.
- Define and own the end-to-end DfD strategy across all technology programs, ensuring every program has a quantified deployment bar (installation duration, workforce management, safety risk, cost per unit install).
- Force multiply deployment teams by creating, optimizing, and driving adoption of DfD mechanisms that enable teams to operate independently and at scale.
- Decompose complex deployment design problems into straightforward infrastructure solutions; define DfD Core Tenets and quantified requirements that engineering designs to across all solutions.
- Establish and evangelize the principle that deployment data is influence currency: creating systems and expectations for teams to document and quantify deployment pain caused by design decisions, replacing anecdotal feedback with systematic, data-driven design influence.
- Remediate critical and/or endemic deployment design problems; make trade-offs between business opportunity, resources, and sustainability with a long-term perspective.
- Identify endemic deployment problems, such as recurring modularity constraints, cable management challenges, or commissioning inefficiencies, diagnosing them and drive engineering to eliminate them at the source rather than compensating in the field.
- Drive measurable DfD outcomes and metrics, such as reduction in deployment duration, cost per unit, first-time installation success rate.

A day in the life
As a Sr. Manager, you will be the person that engineers and design owners come to for the deployment verdict. Your work will have global impact across multiple organizational goals and program-related metrics.

- You'll operate with complete independence in an area where business and infrastructure build strategy may not yet be defined.
- You will spend real time on the floor, next to the machines and the teams installing them, which is exactly where this role earns its credibility and its impact.
- You'll partner with other Robotics teams to validate design improvements and quantify realized savings against targets.
- You'll drive the cultural shift across the organization: coaching teams to stop absorbing complexity and start preventing it, building confidence in deployment engineers to challenge design decisions with data, and establishing new norms where field intelligence flows systematically back to product teams.

No two days will be the same in our fast-paced environment, offering opportunities for strategic impact as part of a collaborative, high-performing team.

About the team
Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation is a diverse and multi-talented team with a proven track record of overcoming challenging technical problems to deliver Amazon’s leading-edge robotics technologies in its fulfillment, transportation, and delivery network across the world. Our high-performing team blends engineering know-how, problem solving, curiosity, innovation, leadership, and effective communication to deliver positive results for our customers.

Have you ever ordered a product from Amazon and been amazed at how fast you receive it? Every day, Amazon engineers are relentlessly working to decrease the time between clicking and delivery for our customers. The Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) organization owns all of the software and infrastructure that powers Amazon’s world-class fulfillment centers, including the fundamental data and services that drive our catalog and inventory systems. AFT builds and operates the software, hardware, and processes that run the global network of fulfillment centers. These systems underlie everything we do – tens of millions of items in the catalog, hundreds of millions of items of inventory, and billions of transactions each year!

AFT is at the forefront of combining HCD, technology, process optimizations, workflow models, sensors etc. to solve complex operational and fulfillment problems. With rapid expansion into new geographies, innovations in supply chain, delivery models and customer experience, increasingly complex transportation network, ever expanding selection of products and growing number of shipments worldwide, we have an opportunity to build software that scales the business, leads the industry through innovation and delights millions of customers worldwide. We leverage latest technologies in big data, optimization techniques, machine learning, real time analytics and high volume, low latency, high availability services.

We're looking for entrepreneurial, innovative individuals who thrive on solving difficult problems. We are investing in a deep technical team to pursue a transformation opportunity around advertising identity. The successful candidate will build upon technical skills and core program management successes.
A Technical Program Manager (TPM) will partner with engineers, other TPMs, Product Managers and senior management to help create world-class solutions. We're looking for people who are passionate about innovating on behalf of customers, demonstrate a high degree of product ownership, and want to have fun while they make history. The ideal TPM is a creative, demonstrated leader with superior analytical abilities and an expeditious drive to deliver results. This opportunity requires deep technical, problem-solving and communication skills.

Key job responsibilities
Engineering execution - drive crisp and timely execution based on customer impact and business opportunity

Priority management - manage diverse requests and dependencies from world-wide teams
Process improvements – define, implement and continuously improve delivery and operational efficiency

Stakeholder management – interface with and influence your stakeholders, balancing business needs vs. technical constraints and driving clarity in ambiguous situations

Operational Excellence – monitor metrics and program health, anticipate and clear blockers, manage escalations

About the team
We are a fast-paced and focused team of passionate Amazonians building Fulfillment solutions used externally. We are standing up fulfillment stack that will scale beyond Amazon sites globally. Our team is part of AFT, and works closely with Amazon Operations, 3rd Party Technical teams following a collaborative engagement model with joint workshops, and dedicated SME support.
The team values high ownership, bias for action, and insists on the highest standards while following a build-fast-and-iterate-fast methodology. We believe in speed through autonomy and safety through guardrails.

This team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to architecture and product strategy while building high-performing, scalable systems that directly impact Amazon internal and external operations and Amazon's growth.

Come join our EU International Technology (EU INTech) team! We are seeking a customer-focused, analytically and technically skilled Sr. Technical Program Manager to innovate on behalf of customers, build effective solutions and deliver initiatives for Selection Availability & Intelligence (SAI).

SAI answers a fundamental question for every item in our catalog: should Amazon carry it, surface it, and grow it? This is a strategic and complex challenges, spanning substitution science, delivery speed perception, cross-border fulfillment, and intelligent selection curation.

Within SAI, the Serra team owns two programs: Zephyr (Substitution) — which identifies nearly identical products that ship faster, arrive sooner, and cost less to fulfill — and Smart Speed, which closes the gap between operational delivery improvements and customer perception of Prime speed. Both programs operate entirely through away-team coordination, requiring alignment across SCOT, PDEX, Cart, Search, BuyX, and international marketplace teams.

The XFN (Cross-Fulfillment Network) team curates and shares domestic and cross-border selection across EU and NA stores. XFN is shifting from simply enabling all selection to intelligently deciding what selection deserves to be assorted — balancing profitability, customer demand, and cost-to-serve through AI-powered tools and selection intelligence frameworks.

We have a roadmap focused on accelerating Serra's experiment velocity across OneDelivery and Delivery Speed CX, while supporting XFN's transformation into an intelligent selection platform. This TPM will own all Serra program delivery end-to-end and support a subset of XFN's highest-priority initiatives, coordinating across science, engineering, and product teams to ship at pace.

Key job responsibilities
- Translate business and technical requirements into actionable roadmaps by partnering with stakeholders across business and tech teams.
- Influence the direction of engineering teams within the organization by collaborating closely with customers in Tech and Business.
- Establish mechanisms that promote agility and engineering excellence through continuous iterations to achieve optimal outcomes.
- Manage program-level schedules and milestones, maintain alignment with multiple competing goals by negotiating and exhibiting influence over authority.
- Own the resource planning, execution, and delivery of projects on the roadmap.
- Assess and manage risks, define and measure success metrics, anticipate and resolve bottlenecks, provide escalation management, make tradeoffs, and balance customer needs with technical constraints.
- Proactively identify and resolve strategic issues that may impair the team's ability to meet business goals.
- Synthesize problems and solutions into a simple and consumable manner, and communicate effectively to a cross-functional audience as a subject matter expert.
- Regularly present work accomplished, challenges faced by teams, and recommend mitigation strategies to senior leadership.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon Supply Chain forms the backbone of the fastest growing ecommerce business in the world. The sheer growth of the business and the company's mission "to be Earth’s most customer-centric company” makes the customer fulfilment business bigger and more complex with each passing year.
Our Supply Chain team is responsible for planning and executing the network for our UK fulfilment business. We work closely with Amazon’s Fulfillment Centers (FCs), Transportation, Retail and Finance teams, orchestrating the upstream and downstream partners to exceed customer expectations while optimizing end-to-end supply chain speed and cost.

We are looking for an analytical and driven Supply Chain Analyst to join our team. In this role, a S&OP Supply Chain Analyst will seek out problems, dive deep into data, earn trust of partner teams, and deliver results that can have a large scale influence. This role is a blend of short term execution and long term strategic planning, that requires quick decision-making, with incomplete data, while also thinking big and influencing the long term direction of the network.
You will be responsible for driving EU level strategic projects and change initiatives in collaboration with multiple stakeholders and in alignment with senior management. You will also work on key analytical projects to drive smarter and optimal decisions within the team.
The end goal of this role is to answer the question of how we can fulfill more products to our customers in a safer, faster, more efficient, and more cost-effective manner.


Key job responsibilities
- Make sound business judgments to drive both tactical as well as strategic improvements
- Own programmatic execution and the detailed and strategic levels
- Identify, prioritize, and implement processes to eliminate defects in the supply chain
- Create, develop, and drive solutions that lead to a richer end to end customer experience
- Successfully operate and influence in a cross-functional capacity


About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) is a paid B2B service that aims to help strategic brands partner with Amazon to grow their business. As a Supply Chain Expert, you will gain 360-degree exposure to all areas of e-commerce at a Pan-EU level, owning the relationship with your brand and structuring with them a short- and long-term strategy oriented at brand’s growth and Customer Satisfaction. You will act as consultant driving selection and promotional activities, monitor and work on success metrics on a daily basis, and ensure the brand’s experience of the AVS demonstrates our customer obsession. Furthermore, you will be working together with different stakeholders to implement new ideas and processes within Amazon EU, such as (Product) Category Management, Supply Chain management, Finance and Marketing; developing your skills and future career. Your role will focus on four crucial business areas:

Core Service: Use your knowledge in deep data analytics to identify EU industry opportunities and provide recommendations to improve overall business performance through the use of Amazon programs (i.e.: Amazon business) to drive long term benefit

Availability & Operational Excellence: Drive EU supply-chain operational excellence initiatives by reducing costs, defects, lead times, and by managing stock in our fulfilment centre.

Promotion & Funding: Provide recommendations for the brand’s marketing and advertising campaigns to promote new products, increase traffic and improve conversion. Plan, implement and manage promotional activities for Amazon events such as Prime Day where you will help your brands to generate sales. On top of that, you will drive brand weeks with you vendors and work closely with Amazon Advertising to explore further marketing opportunities we have.

Selection & IDQ: Help grow selection by managing the launch of new products and improving discoverability. You will identify product gaps, onboard the new products and be responsible for the ramp up of these products, as well as improve the customer journey on Amazon (i.e.: performing walk the store session, competitor benchmarking, create enhanced content on detail pages).

Amazon offers you the chance to build up your own network on a European level by participating in community events such as team activities or by joining some of our affinity groups. Being a Supply Chain Expert is the starting point to accelerating your professional growth within a global leader in e-commerce. Come build the future with us!

target_jobs.description:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we're constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfil and deliver customer orders. Amazon aims to exceed the expectations of our customers by ensuring that their orders, no matter how large or small, are delivered as quickly, accurately, and as cost effectively as possible.
Amazon's Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a Supply Chain Manager in Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) EU, you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders to retail teams and everything in between. You'll help us optimise our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.
As AMXL EU Sr. Supply Chain Manager, Capacity Execution, you will be responsible for managing significant operational and service growth across our European operations as well as implementing standardised process and quality for our Amazon two-person / special handling delivery service. To succeed in this role, you need to be comfortable making business decisions in a fast-paced and evolving work environment and partnering with various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organisation. This role will include a mix of long-term strategic projects and short-term tactical scope. You will bring strong business judgment, deep curiosity about how things work, strong written and oral communication skills, and a passion for creating effective processes and mechanisms that scale.
The role is responsible for the Production Planning, Labour Planning, and Capacity Execution function for AMXL EU, and is located in our Luxembourg Amazon HQ office, with Barcelona corporate offices also available as an option.
You will collaborate with and present to senior stakeholders to shape network-level strategic decisions. You will bring an analytical background that enables you to support network planning and demonstrate the ability to think broadly and strategically about operational initiatives. You will experience a wide range of problem-solving situations, requiring extensive use of data collection and analysis, in partnership with teams including fulfilment operations leadership, HR, finance, supply chain, transportation, and global system development.


Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• Be responsible for Fulfilment Centre, Sort Centre, and Inbound Cross-Dock Labour and Production Planning, Capacity Execution, as well as cost and service optimisation for the EU AMXL network
• Partner with and present to senior leadership, business and finance stakeholders to gather and share data-driven insights
• Support input forecasting using trend analysis and statistical modelling to support decision-making
• Build short, medium, and long-term operational plans to minimise variable costs associated with staffing
• Analyse and solve business problems with a focus on understanding root causes and identifying forward-looking opportunities
• Communicate complex analysis and insights to stakeholders and business leaders, both verbally and in writing
• Participate in global operational and production planning initiatives and project rollouts to support growing business needs
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote process improvement and standardisation across all sites in the network


A day in the life
Being a Supply Chain Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You'll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You'll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to help Amazon achieve new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you'll have the opportunity to help forecast and plan for new projects.
As a Supply Chain Manager, you'll need to help with both operational tasks and more tactical work. No two days will be the same. You could spend one day helping to define our supply chain and operating models and the next assisting with a site's resource plan for a busy period. Having so much variety in your role means you'll be able to learn something new every day.
This role is based at one of our European headquarters in Luxembourg, or at our Barcelona corporate offices.


About the team
Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) looks after heavy and bulky items like furniture and large home appliances. Our team manages the entire service, from supply chain fulfilment, to delivery and returns. What sets this service apart from others is the extra level of customer care. Not only do we deliver large items, but we unpack, assemble and install them, and take away old items where needed. With a focus on safety, productivity and innovation, we're changing the way customers buy and receive large goods for the better.

This is a unique opportunity to apply deep analytical expertise and AI systems to create scalable solutions that help our customers operate efficiently and make informed choices about where and how to deploy resources.

Our team operates at the forefront of innovation, combining technical expertise with business acumen to deliver solutions that matter. We're building the future of controllership and data analytics through AI innovation. Our mission is to empower customers with the insights they need to operate with speed and precision. You'll join a team that values technical depth, continuous learning, and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable strategies.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
The AWS Cloud infrastructure is built around Regions and Availability Zones (AZs). AWS Regions provide multiple, physically separated and isolated Availability Zones which are connected with low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant networking. These Availability Zones offer AWS customers an easier and more effective way to design and operate applications and databases, making them more highly available, fault tolerant, and scalable than traditional single datacenter infrastructures or multi-datacenter infrastructures.

AWS is seeking an exceptional Network Developer to help architect and scale one of the world's most sophisticated networks. As a key member of our Network Planning and Acquisition organization, you will drive innovation in network scaling while maintaining AWS's renowned operational excellence. This role offers the unique opportunity to shape the future of regional and international network infrastructure while solving complex challenges at unprecedented scale. You will leverage your technical expertise and commercial acumen to develop creative solutions that support Amazon's continued growth and expansion. Join us in building the future of cloud infrastructure at AWS, where your contributions will have global impact.

AWS Global Connectivity and Infrastructure Delivery owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global network infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

The candidate will have deep market and industry knowledge in telecommunications; experienced with vendor negotiations, networking technology, business case development and robust financial analysis skills. This individual will actively drive commercial vendor strategy, working with existing vendors, new vendors, as well as the AWS service teams and internal customers to build and design a portfolio of network infrastructure solutions.
This role requires collaboration, driving strategic initiatives and executing commercial deals across our network geography. By applying a unique blend of business and technology experience, you will work closely with both external stakeholders and internal teams to find creative, cost effective, and often innovative solutions to meet Amazon's ongoing growth and expansion needs worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
Network Strategy & Development

- Drive AWS's European metro and backbone network infrastructure strategies

- Design and implement large-scale network architecture supporting Amazon's global operations

- Develop and execute strategic network expansion plans with regular milestone tracking

- Optimize network topology for maximum efficiency and cost-effectiveness

- Monitor and analyze telecommunications market trends, emerging technologies, and industry developments

Vendor & Partnership Management

- Identify and evaluate strategic suppliers for wavelengths, dark fiber, and submarine cable capacity

- Lead technical vendor strategy across AWS's European network topology

- Develop and maintain key commercial and technical partnerships within Europe

- Manage supplier onboarding, performance metrics, and service quality standards

- Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to deliver new backbone capacity

Financial & Project Management

- Collaborate with finance partners on budget planning and allocation

- Manage risk assessment, escalations, and technical constraint resolution

- Balance business requirements with technical limitations and cost considerations

target_jobs.description:
The EU Same Day Data Team builds the data products behind Amazon's fastest delivery promise in Europe. We are looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer II to own speed and cost metrics across the Same Day network and turn complex operational data into decisions that shape how millions of customers get their orders the same day they place them.

You will design and run the pipelines, dashboards, and self-serve datasets that our business partners rely on every day. If you enjoy working close to the operation, building data solutions that scale, and seeing your metrics drive real network changes, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and maintain ETL pipelines on Redshift that turn raw network events into trusted, reusable datasets.
- Own the reporting for offered-speed metrics (latest order cut-off and click-to-promise) and Same Day grocery volume, from source data to executive-ready dashboards.
- Design and publish QuickSight dashboards and self-serve data products so partners can answer their own questions without a bespoke pull each time.
- Define and document metrics so a single number means the same thing across weekly reviews, OP planning, and ad hoc deep dives.
- Investigate anomalies in speed and volume data, trace them to root cause, and communicate findings clearly to technical and business audiences.
- Partner with operations, program, and finance stakeholders to translate business questions into data models and measurable outcomes.
- Apply high engineering standards to the team's assets: version control, code review, monitoring, and ruthless deprecation of what is no longer used.

A day in the life
You start by checking the health of your pipelines and dashboards. Mid-morning you join a Same Day operations review, where your speed and volume metrics anchor the discussion. You spend focused time building a new dataset for a launch, pairing with a colleague on a QuickSight design, and answering a finance partner's question on cost per unit. Your customers are the Same Day operations, program, and finance teams across EU5, and the problems you solve range from a one-off launch deep dive to the metrics that leadership uses to steer the network.

About the team
Our vision is to scale same-day services in Europe by obsessing about excellent data products for our business customers. We provide the centralized data framework for the Same Day organization, covering cost and other operational metrics. We build accessible and sustainable data solutions that adjust to changing priorities, using data engineering, visualization, and AI technologies. We value clear communication, documentation as a byproduct of the work, high technical standards, and investing in the people on the team.

Amazon Web Services is a dynamic and rapidly growing business within Amazon.com. We provide a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. The AWS team is building and delivering the next generation of cloud computing that supports public AWS offerings like S3, EC2, and CloudFront. We are innovating new ways of building massively scalable distributed systems.

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), Security is our highest priority. At AWS' scale, we invent new ways to provide the highest level of assurance to our security conscious customers. AWS Security is looking for a Senior Security Assurance Lead who can prioritize well, communicate early and clearly, and has a solid understanding of security and compliance within a cloud environment.

The Senior Security Assurance Lead will lead AWS Service Assurance activity and be part of the team which is responsible for demonstrating the security controls of services offered by AWS to our customer. This position will be focused on the Service Assurance function, leading on day-to-day security assurance activities, evaluating compliance and providing evidence of how they meet the requirements of our most security conscious customers, whilst developing strategies and mechanisms for how these processes can be completed as seamlessly and effectively as possible.

At AWS we are obsessed with earning and maintaining customer trust. This role facilitates our ability to build and maintain that trust through our internal Security Assurance processes and mechanisms. Ideal candidates will have the ability to learn and comprehend security control implementations and operational effectiveness, AWS services, and IT and cloud auditing processes. They will also be able to evaluate opportunities for improvement, and influence across organizations and teams.

You will be expected to review existing processes and think big to establish long-term strategic mechanisms.

Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate with internal teams and customers to establish baselines and agree the security requirements and associated security controls.
• Manage requests for evidence relating to key security controls, by working in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
• Responsible for reviewing the security of proposed new AWS systems, networks, and software designs for potential system security risks, and resolving integration issues related to the implementation of new services within the existing cloud infrastructure.
• Liaise between key stakeholders and AWS technical communities to articulate security control implementation.
• Dive deep into the Amazon control environment to develop broad domain and technical understanding of our security activities and control implementations to enable these to be articulated to both customers and internal/external stakeholders.
• Work across a wide variety of AWS teams to establish and maintain information security documentation.

About the team
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. Are you passionate about the future of transportation and helping organisations transform how they deliver critical infrastructure and mobility services? Do you have the business acumen and technology leadership background necessary to help establish Amazon Web Services (AWS) as a key technology platform provider across the UK's transport sector?

This is an exciting opportunity to drive growth and shape the future of cloud-native technology adoption across some of the UK's most strategically important transport organisations. You will advise senior public sector leaders on technology strategy and drive adoption across a portfolio spanning rail, roads, aviation, regional transport, and regulatory bodies — helping them harness cloud-native analytics, real-time operations management, and AI-powered optimisation to deliver better outcomes for the travelling public.

You will be joining at a pivotal moment. The UK Government is delivering the most significant restructuring of Britain's railways in a generation through Great British Railways, investing £24 billion in motorways and local roads (2026–2030), and empowering city region transport authorities to lead a £15.6 billion regional investment programme. Across every mode, the challenge is the same: do more with existing networks through technology, not just concrete.

You will possess both a customer-obsessed attitude and a deep understanding of how UK transportation organisations operate — from safety-critical operational environments to complex multi-stakeholder governance — and the challenges they face when making technology decisions. You will have the profile and credibility to facilitate high-level engagement with senior government and industry leaders, and an ability to build relationships at all levels within customer organisations, driving tangible outcomes aligned with the government's vision for technology-enabled transport networks. You are a self-starter who wants to build a business, drive measurable customer outcomes, and make a real difference in how the UK moves.

Key job responsibilities
You will help drive revenue growth and market segment share by developing and executing against a comprehensive business development plan for the UK Transport sector. Central to this is creating and maintaining long-term strategic relationships with Transport leaders, while facilitating strong engagement with key officials, policy makers, advisors, and delivery partners across the ecosystem. You will help define AWS' Transport sector strategy, developing and articulating compelling value propositions around AWS services that resonate with the unique challenges of this market. A key focus will be accelerating customer adoption and strategic partnerships — working with global infrastructure providers, system integrators, and ISVs to extend our reach and drive joint solutions. Throughout, you will ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction, acting as a trusted advisor who balances commercial ambition with genuine customer obsession.

A day in the life

The ABM Solutions & Implementation team within the AWS Global ABM Practice is chartered to define, build, deploy, govern, and enable the solutions that empower 200+ ABM practitioners globally to operate efficiently and at scale. We create, manage, and support the end-to-end delivery of ABM capabilities — from AI-powered technologies to process automation to content management — ensuring our marketers spend less time on manual execution and more time on strategic customer impact.
We are seeking an ABM Program Manager to own and scale the AI, data, and operational solutions that support our ABM community. This role sits at the intersection of marketing and technology: you will take complex, ambiguous problems and deliver AI-based solutions end-to-end — from problem definition through design, build, testing, and global rollout. You will act as the key partner between ABM stakeholders, cross-functional teams (Martech teams, Marketing Operations, and our Integrated Demand Center), and external vendors, translating strategic ABM objectives into scalable solutions.
This role combines strategic thinking with a builder mindset. You will not simply route requirements to a cross-functional support team — you will assess ABM requirements, and where a solution can be built using out-of-the-box AI tools (such as Amazon Quick, MCP integrations, and Asana), you will build it and enable ABMers to use these solutions effectively. Success means ABM practitioners have an integrated, easy-to-use set of AI-powered tools embedded in their daily workflow that adapt as their accounts evolve — delivered with rigor, field-tested adoption, and measurable impact.


Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the business lead for ABM AI, data, and operational solutions end-to-end — define the vision, program strategy, requirements, and success criteria for AI-based ABM solutions with limited guidance, operating in problem spaces where the solution is not yet defined.
• Design and build AI-powered tools and automation flows from problem definition through production — including customer journey engines, Quick Skill automations, MCP integrations across enterprise platforms (CRM, Highspot, Asana), and reactive signal-monitoring layers that keep solutions current as accounts evolve.
• Drive delivery and support of complex, cross-functional solutions — including design, AppSec compliance, build, user acceptance testing with field practitioners, documentation (SOPs and training guides), product demonstrations, and global rollout.
• Serve as the key partner between marketing stakeholders, cross-functional teams (Martech teams, Marketing Operations, and our Integrated Demand Center), and external vendors — translating business requirements into technical specifications, and communicating technical constraints back to marketing stakeholders.
• Drive AI enablement and adoption across a globally distributed practitioner community — assess AI maturity, build leveling frameworks, deploy Quick Skills tooling, and coach practitioners (e.g., via a Champions program) to scale adoption across all Geos.
• Spot risks and drive appropriate trade-offs — understand design approaches within the ABM technology domain (AI/ML frameworks, MCP integrations, data sources, agent orchestration, UI/UX) and ask the right questions to ensure sound decisions.
• Define, track, and report on program KPIs (adoption, usage volume, practitioner impact, time savings, delivery quality). Use data to identify bottlenecks, drive improvements, and inform investment decisions.
• Create new processes and mechanisms — AI solution generation workflows, orchestration patterns, coaching methodologies, and global rollout mechanisms — and optimize cross-team delivery across engineering and marketing organizations.
• Facilitate cross-functional decision-making forums with leaders, technical program managers, and vendors to secure resources, align priorities, and drive timely decisions. Present decisions and program status to senior leadership.
• Partner with the Martech team on ABM solution lifecycle management — contributing requirements and field-informed input to platform builds such as buying-group identification services, account planning platforms, and ABM experience products.

Are you passionate about the future of aviation and helping organisations transform how they deliver safe, efficient, and seamless air travel experiences? Do you have the business acumen and technology leadership background necessary to help establish Amazon Web Services (AWS) as a key technology platform provider across the UK's aviation sector?

This is an exciting opportunity to drive growth and shape the future of cloud-native technology adoption across some of the UK's most critical aviation infrastructure operators — from the world's busiest international airport to the organisation managing millions of flights through UK airspace annually.

You will be joining at a pivotal moment as UK aviation surpasses pre-pandemic passenger volumes, operators face intensifying regulatory and commercial pressure to modernise safety-critical systems, and the UK Government's transport infrastructure investment programme explicitly ties funding to technology adoption. Your role will be to help these organisations harness AI, IoT, and cloud-native architectures for real-time operations management, predictive maintenance, and passenger experience optimisation — where system reliability carries the highest possible safety implications.

You will possess both a customer-obsessed attitude and a strong understanding of how UK aviation organisations operate — from airport operators and air navigation service providers to regulators — and the unique challenges they face when making technology decisions in safety-critical, highly regulated environments. You will have an ability to build relationships at all levels within customer organisations, driving tangible outcomes aligned with the sector's twin imperatives of operational resilience and passenger experience transformation. You are a self-starter who wants to build a business, drive measurable customer outcomes, and make a real difference in how the UK flies.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive revenue growth and market share across the Roads, Regulation, and Regional Transport territory, encompassing National Highways, DfT, TfL, TfGM, TfWM, DVLA, and DVSA
- Develop and execute a comprehensive account development plan aligned with major government investment programmes and customer digital transformation priorities
- Build and maintain long-term strategic relationships with senior leaders across central government departments, arm's length bodies, and regional passenger transport executives
- Develop and articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services including cloud-native analytics, AI/ML, IoT, and data platform modernisation
- Identify and progress opportunities in areas such as multi-cloud displacement, digital twin, legacy migration, real-time traffic management, and regulatory digital services
- Coordinate and manage partner ecosystems to achieve partner-attached rate targets and extend market reach
- Understand the technical requirements of customers and collaborate with Solutions Architects, Specialist teams, and Professional Services to shape compelling solutions
- Facilitate engagement with key officials, policy makers, advisors, and delivery partners across the transport ecosystem
- Present business reviews to senior management regarding progress, pipeline development, and roadblocks to expanding our reach in the territory


A day in the life
As an Account Manager in the Aviation territory, no two days are the same. You might start the morning preparing for a strategic engagement with Manchester Airports Group leadership on their AI-powered Digital Colleague Workplace programme, before joining a cross-functional working session with Solutions Architects and partners to shape a proposal for NATS' next-generation air traffic management platform.

In the afternoon, you could be facilitating a workshop with Heathrow on how data analytics can optimise airport operations and passenger flow, followed by a pipeline review with your manager and specialist overlay teams. You'll regularly engage with DfT aviation policy teams to understand how airspace modernisation and sustainability targets create technology opportunities, and work with the CAA on regulatory digital service transformation.

Your internal stakeholders include Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Partner teams, and Specialist sales overlays. Your customers are senior technology and operational leaders within airports, air navigation service providers, airlines, and aviation regulatory bodies. The problems you solve span infrastructure modernisation, safety-critical systems transformation, data-driven operational efficiency, and enabling the sector's ambition to deliver safer, more sustainable, and better-connected aviation through technology.

About the team
The AWS Transport team sits within UK Public Sector and is dedicated to helping the UK's transport organisations deliver better outcomes through cloud technology. We work across rail, aviation, roads, and regional transport — partnering with some of the country's most complex and strategically important organisations as they navigate generational transformation programmes.

Our mission is to be the trusted technology partner that enables the UK transport sector to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. We believe that cloud, data, and AI are fundamental enablers of the government's vision for a modern, integrated transport network.

We are a collaborative, ambitious team that values diverse perspectives and deep customer empathy. We celebrate curiosity, reward ownership, and are passionate about making a tangible difference in how millions of people travel every day.

Are you passionate about the future of rail and helping organisations transform how they deliver critical infrastructure and passenger services? Do you have the business acumen and technology leadership background necessary to help establish Amazon Web Services (AWS) as a key technology platform provider across the UK's rail sector?

This is an exciting opportunity to drive growth and shape the future of cloud-native technology adoption across some of the UK's most strategically important rail organisations — including Great British Railways (GBR), Network Rail, the Department for Transport Operator (DfTO), Rail Delivery Group, and the growing portfolio of publicly-owned train operating companies.

You will be joining at a pivotal moment as the UK Government delivers the most significant restructuring of Britain's railways in a generation. The Railways Bill establishes Great British Railways as a publicly owned company consolidating 17 organisations — unifying operational control of 20,000 miles of track, 2,500 stations, and digital systems currently fragmented across more than twenty train operating companies into a single digital estate. With GBR targeting operational status by 2027 and a £3.5 billion efficiency mandate, your role will be to help these organisations harness cloud-native data platforms, AI-powered predictive maintenance, and unified digital architectures to improve performance, reduce cancellations, and deliver a railway that is cheaper, greener, and more reliable.

You will possess both a customer-obsessed attitude and a strong understanding of how UK rail organisations operate — from safety-critical signalling systems to passenger information platforms — and the challenges they face when making technology decisions in a highly regulated, politically sensitive environment. You will have an ability to build relationships at all levels within customer organisations, driving tangible outcomes aligned with GBR's five strategic priorities: performance and reliability, passenger-first experience, financial sustainability, strategic innovation, and breaking down organisational barriers. You are a self-starter who wants to build a business, drive measurable customer outcomes, and make a real difference in how Britain's railway serves its passengers.

Key job responsibilities
Drive revenue growth and market share across the UK Rail territory, encompassing Great British Railways (GBR), Network Rail, DfT Operator (DfTO), Rail Delivery Group, and the expanding portfolio of publicly-owned train operating companies

Develop and execute a comprehensive account development plan aligned with the GBR transformation programme, the Railways Bill implementation timeline, and customer digital consolidation priorities as 17+ organisations merge into a single rail body

Build and maintain long-term strategic relationships with senior leaders across GBR Shadow Board, Network Rail executive leadership, DfTO, train operating company managing directors, and the Office of Rail and Road

Develop and articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services including unified data platforms, AI/ML-powered predictive maintenance, IoT for asset monitoring, and cloud-native passenger information systems

Identify and progress opportunities in areas such as multi-cloud displacement, legacy mainframe migration, unified ticketing and retail platforms, digital twin for infrastructure planning, real-time train performance management, and AI-driven timetable optimisation

Coordinate and manage partner ecosystems to achieve partner-attached rate targets and extend market reach across rail-specialist systems integrators and ISVs

Understand the technical requirements of customers operating in safety-critical, regulated environments and collaborate with Solutions Architects, Specialist teams, and Professional Services to shape compelling solutions that meet rail industry assurance standards

Facilitate engagement with key officials, policy makers, rail industry bodies, and delivery partners across the rail ecosystem — including the Rail Safety and Standards Board (RSSB), Transport Focus, and devolved transport authorities

Present business reviews to senior management regarding progress, pipeline development, and roadblocks to expanding our reach across the rail territory


A day in the life
As an Account Manager in the UK Rail territory, no two days are the same. You might start the morning preparing for a strategic engagement with Great British Railways leadership on their technology roadmap, before joining a cross-functional working session with Solutions Architects and partners to shape a proposal for Network Rail's next-generation environment.

In the afternoon, you could be facilitating a workshop with a Rail Operator on how AI-powered analytics can optimise timetabling, followed by a pipeline review with your manager and specialist overlay teams.

Your internal stakeholders include Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Partner teams, and Specialist sales overlays. Your customers are senior technology and operational leaders within Great British Railways, Network Rail, publicly-owned train operating companies, and rail industry bodies. The problems you solve span infrastructure modernisation, safety-critical systems migration, data-driven performance management, and enabling GBR's ambition to deliver a more reliable, efficient, and passenger-focused railway through technology.

About the team
The AWS Transport team sits within UK Public Sector and is dedicated to helping the UK's transport organisations deliver better outcomes through cloud technology. We work across rail, aviation, roads, and regional transport — partnering with some of the country's most complex and strategically important organisations as they navigate generational transformation programmes.

Our mission is to be the trusted technology partner that enables the UK transport sector to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. We believe that cloud, data, and AI are fundamental enablers of the government's vision for a modern, integrated transport network.

We are a collaborative, ambitious team that values diverse perspectives and deep customer empathy. We operate with a start-up mentality within the scale of AWS — meaning you'll have the autonomy to shape your territory strategy while being supported by world-class technical, partner, and specialist resources. We celebrate curiosity, reward ownership, and are passionate about making a tangible difference in how millions of people travel every day.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and own the Advanced Compute pipeline for UKGI: identify, qualify, and progress opportunities for Graviton, Trainium, Inferentia, and GPU across UK public sector accounts.

- Develop the go-to-market strategy for AWS silicon in sovereign and on-premises contexts.

- Support account teams on active GPU deals - providing technical positioning, commercial structuring, and deep market expertise.

- Build the demand signal from UK government: aggregate requirements and translate customer intent into product roadmap input.

- Develop customer-facing propositions around confidential computing on Graviton, on-premises silicon deployment, and sovereign AI compute.

About the team
The AI, Emerging Tech & Customer Acceleration team is the specialist engine supporting UKGI account teams. Our job is to find new markets, bring deep technical and commercial skills into the biggest deals, and accelerate the time between opportunity and outcome for UK public sector customers.

The Regional Higher Ed Lead is the single point of ownership for AWS Academy within an assigned geographic territory. This role is accountable for growing and managing a portfolio of higher education institutions advising on technical curriculum and cloud/AI strategy and serving as the trusted advisor connecting institutions to the right combination of AWS education programs. You will own the institutional relationship end-to-end - from pipeline development through onboarding through long-term account health - while defining the technical standards and requirements that ensure institutions successfully implement and deliver Academy courses. You will work across AWS teams (sales public sector partner organizations curriculum and platform engineering) to bring coordinated value to higher education institutions in your region.

Key job responsibilities
• Institution Pipeline & Business Development Identify prospect and onboard new institutions into AWS Academy. Build and manage a pipeline of prospective institutions from inquiry through active enrollment. Grow adoption within existing accounts by expanding program presence into new departments and degree programs. Coordinate with AWS Sales field teams on Academy opportunities and identify areas of collaboration with public sector public policy and partner organizations to create scalability.
• Account Management & Relationship Ownership Serve as the primary point of contact for all institutions within the territory. Drive retention expansion and educator readiness across assigned accounts. Build long-term relationships with institutional stakeholders - department chairs deans and provost-level leadership. Shepherd dormant institutions back to active status. Ensure educator nominations and readiness-to-teach milestones are met. Track regional KPIs including learner completions institution growth and educator engagement.
• Technical Advisory & Curriculum Strategy Advise institutions and educators on AWS cloud and AI curriculum architecture course sequencing and how Academy programs map to degree requirements. Communicate technical training standards and curriculum development best practices to institutional partners. Understand and articulate technical aspects of LMS integration (LTI protocols Canvas configuration SSO/SAML) lab environment requirements (Vocareum AWS Labs) and platform capabilities. Define technical requirements for institution setup and ensure institutions can successfully deploy and deliver Academy courses.
• Program Execution & Cross-Functional Coordination Execute global business development and event playbooks locally - including AWS Jams hackathons and vibe coding sessions. Coordinate with the Technical Enablement Lead on content standards and educator readiness requirements. Work with the Business Development & Strategy Lead on go-to-market motions and marketing activities in-region. Advocate internally for institutional needs across AWS teams. Connect institutions to the right combination of AWS programs - Academy Education Equity Initiative Cloud Clubs Skills to Jobs - based on institutional needs.

You re-engage a dormant institution and connect a new prospect to the right AWS programs. You own each relationship end-to-end.

Amazon is innovating in the Operations and Logistics space and looking for a driven, entrepreneurial, and analytical Business Development Manager to join Amazon Shipping UK. Amazon Shipping has exciting plans to accelerate growth across 2026 and beyond, and we are looking for talented individuals to join us on this journey.

The successful Business Developer will be comfortable navigating ambiguity and operating in a start-up environment. We expect the person in this position to be a self-starter, create a sales strategy using self-prospected leads, and be comfortable defining their own structure and ways of working. Our path is not always simple, so we are selective about who joins us on this journey. There is a certain kind of person who takes on this role at Amazon – someone who is excited by the idea of creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company whose ship cycles are measured in weeks, not years. How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow. 
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. The Amazon EU Student Programs Team are looking for ambitious students to join us as interns at the heart of our core consumer business! Internships are flexible in length to fit in with your university’s placement scheme.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop analytical solutions to business problems that utilize the highest standards of analytical rigor and data integrity
• Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation
• Write high quality code to retrieve and analyze data
• Analyze and solve business problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context
• Design pragmatic analyses and automated metrics that add value to your business area
• Understand data resources and how, when, and what to use (and what not to use).
• Develop analyses (whether fully formed or exploratory) for the business’ sake, not for analyses’ sake
• Seek to understand the business objectives relevant to your area, and align your work to those objectives and seek to deliver business value
• Proactively and continually, improve your level of knowledge about Amazon’s business and relevant data resources

A day in the life
Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment.

Inclusive Team Culture
Our team is intentional about attracting, developing, and retaining amazing talent from diverse backgrounds. Yes, we do get to build a really cool service, but we also think a big reason for that is inclusive and welcoming culture we try to cultivate every day.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We care about your career growth. Whether your goals are to explore new design concepts, take on bigger opportunities, or get to the next level, we'll help you get there. Our business is growing fast and our people will grow with it.

Responsible for building effective partnerships with our Campaign Managers and Creative teams, they are able to manage creative development, production, localization, and drive cross functional team alignment within our XCM teams, business partners and external agencies.

With global energy demand projected to rise 47% over the next 25 years, the Energy sector is simultaneously navigating a global expansion of existing and new energy sources, an AI driven transformation of subsurface, reservoir intelligence, real-time drilling operations, and agentic production optimization in Oil and Gas; and in Power and Utilities, an acceleration of grid modernization, decarbonization mandates, electrification of mobility, and growth in generation. These are transformational opportunities not seen in decades. At the same time, AWS is deploying billions in annual capital expenditure for power generation and delivery arrangements to support sustainable data center growth. AWS is co-investing in diverse supply like wind, solar, storage, and nuclear and creating more agile, responsive, and efficient energy workflows using AI and the cloud with leading Energy customers. This convergence creates an unprecedented opportunity—and an imperative—for AWS to lead at the intersection of AI, cloud technology, and energy infrastructure. Our mission is simple: to generate unprecedented value for Energy customers by reinventing their workflows with Agentic AI.

AWS is seeking a Director to lead the Business Development function for the Energy and Utilities Industry Business Unit. This leader is responsible for the industry Go-To-Market (GTM) that drives cloud and AI adoption across the Oil and Gas (O&G) and Power and Utilities (P&U) sectors, and for the integration of commercial relationships of companies delivering power to Amazon into a 360, strategic relationship. The Energy BD organization touches every facet of how AWS engages energy and utilities customers and the AWS strategic industry position. The BD team engages in account planning, demand generation, development of cloud and AI Strategic Framework Agreements (SFAs), industry go-to-market strategy, solution development, partner ecosystem engagement, and field enablement for AWS Energy customers worldwide.

In this role, you will define and execute the multi-year strategy for how AWS engages the global Energy sector as a customer, partner, and infrastructure counterpart to drive cloud and AI growth. You will lead a globally distributed team of senior business development professionals who structure large, multi-party commercial agreements, manage CxO-level relationships, define the industry strategy, build the opportunity pipeline, enable regional and global account teams, and engage strategic ISV and systems integrator partners to accelerate cloud adoption across the sector. This role that demands credibility at the intersection of energy infrastructure, enterprise AI and cloud technology, and large-scale commercial deal-making.

You will serve as the managed gateway between Energy & Utilities account teams and AWS Infrastructure teams and other Amazon organizations, ensuring that requests and commercial discussions with power procurement teams are appropriately coordinated, triaged, and elevated. You will leverage and continuously expand a pan-Amazon network spanning Amazon Retail, Prime, Transportation, Fulfillment, Data Center Infrastructure, Sustainability, Amazon Business, and other Amazon business units, bringing the full breadth of Amazon's assets and capabilities into strategic customer relationships. You will facilitate executive engagements between customer C-suites and senior Amazon leadership and represent AWS at the highest-profile energy industry forums.

You will partner with AWS Sales, Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, AWS Infrastructure, and service team leadership to align commercial and technical priorities, influence AWS product and infrastructure investment direction, and build mechanisms that drive repeatable, scalable outcomes across the Strategic BD organization.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and execute a comprehensive strategic GTM plan for the global Power & Utilities sector, including industry solution prioritization, repeatable pipeline generation, market segmentation, and competitive positioning
- Identify, develop, and realize business opportunities to generate customer value and AWS AI/cloud revenue, building a business development pipeline in line with the AWS Energy industry strategic direction and multi-year revenue targets
- Structure and execute Strategic Framework Agreements (SFAs) encompassing Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) and Cloud and AI deployments at scale with the world's largest energy companies
- Lead, develop, and grow a global team of senior business development professionals articulating how AWS can solve the hardest industry problems with Agentic AI and cloud, instilling a sense of urgency, coaching on multi-divisional deal structuring, CxO engagement, providing visible industry thought leadership, and fostering a culture of ownership and high performance
- Serve as the primary strategic advisor to energy industry executives at the CEO, CFO, CIO, CTO, and VP level, building trusted bilateral relationships that span both commercial infrastructure partnerships and enterprise cloud and AI adoption programs
- Manage the pan-Amazon relationship network to bring the full breadth of Amazon assets—Retail, Prime, Transportation, Fulfillment, Data Center Infrastructure, Amazon Business, Sustainability, and others—into strategic customer engagements as inputs to SFA value propositions and commercial deal structures
- Define and size market segments; identify, qualify, and engage key customers and strategic industry partners and develop scalable partner engagement and co-sell motions
- Build and maintain named account/ white-space map across Energy and utilities, prioritized by propensity and strategic value
- Hand off qualified opportunities to Sales with clear documentation of the customer's business driver, stakeholders and urgency
- Coordinate regional and global field enablement initiatives, including account team training programs, infrastructure engagement playbooks, industry solution toolkits, and mechanisms that equip AWS field teams to engage confidently in energy infrastructure and cloud deals
- Work with Marketing to drive global campaigns highlighting customer success stories and strategic messaging.

AWS offers over 200 fully featured services to millions of active customers around the world—including the fastest-growing start-ups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—to power their organisations and underpin their digital transformation

Would you like to be part of a team focused on increasing adoption of AWS in complex enterprises? Do you have the business savvy and the technical background necessary to help establish AWS as a key strategic partner? As we embark on the next stage of our growth, we’re seeking ambitious sale people with a proven track record in account management roles and selling complex IT solutions into large enterprises.

The successful candidate will drive digital transformation through impactful engagements with C-level executives, line of business leaders and technology professionals. In this role, you will represent the entire portfolio of AWS across the highest profile commercial organisations in the UK and with the greatest potential to be the next significant, strategic AWS customers.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services

Are you ready to take on this unique and high visibility challenge?

Key job responsibilities
• Drive AWS business growth in a defined territory supporting early engaged accounts within the Industrials sector; Build and leverage relationships with internal and external stakeholders to further the adoption of AWS services in the market;
• Accelerate customer adoption through well-developed sales strategies and successful go-to-market engagements to achieve customer outcomes;
• Act in a customer obsessed way that delights our customers, enables innovation, underpins transformation and delivers outstanding outcomes;
• Deliver against a combination of agreed quantitative and qualitative goals;
• Develop and work with partners to extend the reach and drive AWS cloud adoption
• Engage in a way that ensures an outstanding customer experience


About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Amazon is seeking a European VAT Senior Manager to lead VAT strategy, risk governance, and policy across multi-jurisdictional operations throughout Europe. This role combines deep technical VAT expertise with strategic leadership, driving scalable compliance frameworks, influencing senior decision-making, and setting the direction for complex, cross-border VAT matters.

Key job responsibilities
This position will lead cross-functional engagement with senior business partners, legal, operations, and tax leadership to shape strategy, define governance frameworks, and drive alignment on complex VAT matters across multiple jurisdictions and business lines. The role requires setting the strategic direction for VAT risk management and influencing organisational priorities at a senior level.
In order to be successful, the candidate must demonstrate strategic vision and high judgment, setting priorities for multi-disciplinary teams, making decisions with significant business, regulatory, or financial implications, and determining where to allocate resources for maximum impact. The candidate must operate with independence and bring clarity to complexity.

The candidate must:
• Have deep, recognized expertise in VAT across multiple jurisdictions, with a proven track record of leading complex advisory engagements, setting organisational tax positions, and influencing business strategy at a senior leadership level; and
• Be able to lead and own the resolution of the most complex audit and controversy matters, developing strategy, managing external advisors, and driving outcomes with tax authorities across multiple jurisdictions.
• Be able to communicate complex VAT matters with clarity and conviction to executive audiences, bringing strategic recommendations, not just analysis, and driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
• Be a trusted business partner to senior leaders, effectively influencing and challenging decisions across organisations.



A day in the life
This position owns the strategic direction of VAT planning and risk management across the portfolio, leading large-scale, cross-functional programmes from conception through execution.
The role is accountable for identifying and mitigating material VAT risks, developing and embedding governance frameworks, and ensuring organisational readiness for regulatory change. The incumbent will establish mechanisms for continuous improvement, determine resource allocation, and report directly to senior leadership on exposure, remediation, and strategic priorities.
