target_jobs.description:
As a member of our Customer Fulfilment (CF) Finance team, you will help leaders turn data into insight so we can keep delivering an excellent experience for our customers and find new ways to support them. We are trusted business advisors: we bring a holistic financial perspective and partner with the business to make the best possible decisions.
This role gives you a front-row seat to how those decisions are made, and the opportunity to own meaningful analysis, influence outcomes, and grow.

About the Team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. From a team of booksellers, CF has scaled into a sophisticated global network that handles millions of orders every day. Our Fulfilment Centres are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced operations — often called the “First Mile” because it is where most Amazon packages begin their journey.
As CF Finance, we work closely with our Operations partners to ensure leaders have reliable, up-to-date information to take the right decisions. We value the different perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets our people bring — they make us stronger.



Key job responsibilities
• Build reports and financial models that inform forecasting, planning and problem-solving, and share your analysis to support strategic decisions.
• Dive deep to understand what is driving performance, identify root causes behind variances, and propose actionable recommendations.
• Own recurring financial and operational reporting, ensuring accuracy and providing clear, timely commentary to stakeholders.
• Build trusted relationships with business partners, use narratives, data and analysis to influence decisions, and challenge assumptions where the data tells a different story.
• Lead or contribute to projects that scale processes, strengthen controllership, or add value.
• Simplify and improve: automate processes, reduce defects, and make your deliverables easier for everyone to use.
• Communicate findings clearly and concisely — both verbally and in writing — including to non-finance partners and senior leaders, even as topics grow more complex.
• Contribute to the team by building and maintaining tools, SOPs and documentation, sharing knowledge with others, and supporting the onboarding and development of colleagues.


A day in the life
You use data to build reports and financial models that answer difficult business questions. You dive into cost drivers and productivity metrics, and when performance moves away from plan, you look for the story behind the numbers. You sit side by side with your Operations partners, translating data into clear, actionable insight and aligning on the right path forward.

You work independently on your own analysis while partnering closely with colleagues across the business. You will be based in one of our corporate offices and may visit our sites from time to time to ground your analysis in real operational context. No two weeks look exactly the same, and that variety is part of what makes the role rewarding.

AWS is seeking a Senior GenAI/ML Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA) for large enterprise customers in United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland (UKI). You'll be instrumental in driving the adoption of AWS GenAI/ML services while helping organizations achieve their innovation and transformation goals through GenAI/ML architectures.

This role requires technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs. As part of the AGS organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex requirements that require expert-level knowledge to solve. You must have deep technical expertise in Generative AI and Machine Learning services, enterprise-grade architectural strategies, and a passion for solving complex business challenges. We are looking for technical experts who can bridge the gap between innovative AI technologies and practical business outcomes for our customers.

You'll work directly with a diverse top range of customers in UKI to help them make optimal technical decisions in their AI/ML journey, balancing innovation with practical constraints and compliance requirements. You'll have the opportunity to build enduring relationships with these organizations and establish yourself as a trusted technical advisor in the rapidly evolving field of Generative AI and Machine Learning.

Key job responsibilities
1. Technical Expertise & Solution Design: Provide customers with deep technical expertise in Generative AI and Machine Learning technologies, designing innovative solutions that help them meet strategic business objectives using AWS products

2. Customer Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to line of business, AI, Data, and C-suite leaders, translating complex technical concepts into business value and guiding their AI transformation journey

3. Technical Leadership: Lead architectural reviews, workshops, and proof-of-concepts to advance customers' technical objectives and validate proposed solutions

4. Thought Leadership: Share best practices through AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures, and helping to educate the broader technical community

5. Product Feedback & Innovation: Gather customer insights to inform AWS product teams about market needs and opportunities, contributing to the evolution of AWS GenAI/ML services based on real-world implementation experience

You bring hands-on experience designing and implementing machine learning solutions, including model training, deployment, and inference at scale, with working knowledge of AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, and scikit-learn. You have a background in a customer-facing technical role (solutions architect, ML engineer, data scientist, or technical consultant) and can communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including C-suite executives. Ideally, you also have experience with large language models (LLMs), foundation models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning, prompt engineering, or agentic AI architectures. The Senior PDM will own the end-to-end partner relationship, operating as a trusted advisor at the executive level. You will define the partnership narrative, shape joint go-to-market strategies, and drive measurable business outcomes across your portfolio. This is not an execution-only role — you will independently set direction for your partners, identify new growth opportunities, and influence both internal and external stakeholders to align on strategic priorities.

The ideal candidate combines strong business judgment with the ability to engage credibly at CxO level. You are comfortable operating across technology domains, can quickly develop conviction on a partner's value proposition, and translate that into actionable joint GTM motions. You think long-term, act with urgency, and thrive in ambiguity.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the partner portfolio — serve as the single-threaded leader for a portfolio of ISVs across the EMEA region in a specific category (e.g., Security, Data & AI, DevOps, Application Modernisation, GenAI)
• Be the strategic advisor — develop deep understanding of each partner's business, product roadmap, and growth ambitions; provide informed guidance on how to maximise their success on AWS
• Own the executive narrative — craft and deliver compelling partnership stories at VP/C-level both internally and externally; position AWS as the partner's cloud of choice through thought leadership and strategic engagement
• Drive AWS Marketplace adoption — accelerate partners' Marketplace listing, transaction, and co-sell motions; identify opportunities to simplify customer procurement and drive measurable revenue through the channel
• Develop joint go-to-market strategies — build and execute partner business plans aligned to AWS field priorities; coordinate co-sell motions with AWS account teams across EMEA
• Identify and develop new opportunities — spot whitespace across partner capabilities, emerging technology trends (GenAI, Agentic AI, SaaS modernisation), and customer demand signals; translate these into new joint value propositions
• Influence cross-functional teams — orchestrate Partner Solutions Architects, Partner Marketing, ISV Sales, and AWS field teams to deliver against partner goals
• Drive partner-level goals — own revenue targets, pipeline metrics, Marketplace transaction growth, and strategic milestones; report progress and propose corrective actions to leadership
• Build executive relationships — develop and maintain VP/CxO-level relationships at partners and within AWS; broker alignment on strategic priorities and escalations
• Raise the bar — contribute to team mechanisms, share best practices, and mentor peers; bring outside-in thinking to continuously improve how the EMEA ISV team operates

Diverse Experiences

The role ensures operational practices are robust, scalable, and fully aligned with regulatory obligations, while providing actionable insights to senior leadership and proactively mitigating VAT exposure.

The Senior Manager will work closely with tax colleagues, business operations, internal audit, and risk monitoring teams to embed controls into business processes, challenge operational readiness, and influence decision-making across the organization.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of VAT risk and assurance frameworks, control methodologies, and operational procedures.
• Oversee assurance activities, guiding analysts in data collection, testing, evaluation of control effectiveness, and review of VAT requirements developed by VAT advisory teams.
• Critically review VAT requirements from VAT advisory teams to identify gaps, weaknesses, or conflicts prior to operational rollout.
• Foster cross-functional collaboration with business, operational, risk management, and VAT teams to embed robust controls into daily operations, implement process improvements, and ensure alignment with organisational objectives.
• Challenge operational readiness for new controls and processes, reviewing UAT outcomes, SOPs, and minimum standards before launch.
• Report to senior leadership on VAT risk exposure, assurance findings, and remediation progress with clear, actionable recommendations.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon is seeking an Indirect Tax Senior Manager to join the EMEA Digital and Devices Tax team in London, supporting the launch and growth of Amazon Leo's consumer business across Europe.
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low earth orbit satellite network, with a mission to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities beyond the reach of existing networks (https://leo.amazon.com/gb/en/). As Leo launches its consumer offering across EMEA, the successful candidate will lead the indirect tax position for the B2C business, working closely with Business, Engineering, Finance, Legal and external advisors to shape the tax treatment of Leo’s new consumer service from the outset.
The role will offer exposure to a broad range of jurisdictions and technical topics, including telecommunications services, bundled offerings of connectivity and hardware, design of consumer billing systems, place of supply for cross-border flows, and the interaction between indirect tax, direct tax, transfer pricing and accounting. There will also be scope for engagement with local tax authorities through enquiries and audits as they arise.


Key job responsibilities
The role provides indirect tax advisory support to the Amazon Leo consumer business across EMEA, covering the Leo satellite internet service, associated consumer hardware, and bundled or promotional offerings sold to consumers.
The role involves:
1. Leading the indirect tax position for the Leo consumer launch across EMEA, from strategy through go-live and into steady-state operation.
2. Advising on new features and product changes, including bundling of connectivity with hardware and other services.
3. Partnering with Leo business teams early in the product development cycle to ensure tax considerations are reflected in business requirements documents.
4. Working with Engineering to translate tax requirements into system logic, resolving open points and driving the testing approach to ensure a compliant launch.
5. Advising on customer-facing outputs, including invoicing, billing system design, pricing displays and customer communications.
6. Managing external advisors: setting the scope of advice, independently evaluating the output and reaching a sound position.
7. Handling engagement with tax authorities across EMEA, including audits, enquiries and informal engagement, in coordination with compliance colleagues.
8. Providing technical direction to more junior colleagues supporting the business line.
The role is primarily advisory, working closely with compliance colleagues on registrations, returns, audits and process improvements.

A day in the life
The role typically involves moving between three types of work. Advisory work with Product and Engineering on features under development, ensuring that tax treatment is understood, agreed and implemented before launch. Ongoing support for the live business, including advisor queries, positions to be documented, and questions raised by Finance or Legal. Ad-hoc work, including engagement with tax authorities, review of legislative changes across EMEA, and support for wider planning work across the digital services and consumer devices portfolio where relevant.

About the team
The team supports Amazon's digital services and consumer devices businesses across EMEA. The team advises a portfolio of businesses covering streaming (Prime Video, Amazon MGM Studios, Amazon Music), digital content (Kindle, Audible), connected devices (Alexa, Ring) and now satellite broadband, and works directly with business teams and cross-functional stakeholders including accounting, legal, finance and tax. The team's focus is on providing clear, commercial and robust tax positions that allow the business to move forward with confidence, and on engaging early in the product development cycle to ensure tax outcomes are delivered at launch.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon Supply Chain forms the backbone of the fastest growing ecommerce business in the world. The sheer growth of the business and the company's mission "to be Earth’s most customer-centric company” makes the customer fulfilment business bigger and more complex with each passing year.

Our Supply Chain team is responsible for planning and executing the network for our UK fulfilment business. We work closely with Amazon’s Fulfillment Centers (FCs), Transportation, Retail and Finance teams, orchestrating the upstream and downstream partners to exceed customer expectations while optimizing end-to-end supply chain speed and cost.

We are looking for an analytical and driven Supply Chain Analyst to join our team. In this role, an Execution Supply Chain Analyst will seek out problems, dive deep into data, earn trust of partner teams, and deliver results that can have a large scale influence. This role is a blend of short term execution and long term strategic planning, that requires quick decision-making, with incomplete data, while also thinking big and influencing the long term direction of the network.
You will be responsible for driving EU level strategic projects and change initiatives in collaboration with multiple stakeholders and in alignment with senior management. You will also work on key analytical projects to drive smarter and optimal decisions within the team.
The end goal of this role is to answer the question of how we can fulfill more products to our customers in a safer, faster, more efficient, and more cost-effective manner.


Key job responsibilities
- Make sound business judgments to drive both tactical as well as strategic improvements
- Own programmatic execution and the detailed and strategic levels
- Identify, prioritize, and implement processes to eliminate defects in the supply chain
- Create, develop, and drive solutions that lead to a richer end to end customer experience
- Successfully operate and influence in a cross-functional capacity
- Provide analytical deep dives and models to better guide network execution and strategy


About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help Global Financial Services customers across capital markets, insurance, and banking and payments gain the best value and service from AWS?

At AWS Support we're looking for a Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level services, Networking, Serverless, and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to some of the world's largest financial services organizations.

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively as part of the AWS Unified Operations (UOps) delivery model to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, regulatory requirements, support, and risk management. You will operate as a trusted technical peer to your customers' senior technology leaders owning the cloud strategy conversation end-to-end - defining where the customer is heading why and what success looks like.

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy through application-specific reviews proactive monitoring and custom runbooks. You will establish and evolve frameworks governing customer operations on AWS including DevSecOps practices, Operational Excellence standards, AI strategy, and Target Operating Models. You will use generative AI tools fluently to accelerate your own work and more importantly to unlock deeper insights and proactive recommendations for your customers. You will guide customers on adopting AWS generative AI services to modernise their operations and drive measurable business outcomes. You will leverage AI agents for workload discovery review and risk identification steering agent outputs into actionable strategies that help customers move faster and with greater confidence. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!

Key job responsibilities
• Work proactively as part of the AWS Unified Operations (UOps) delivery model to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.
• Effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment leveraging your technical acumen and customer-facing skills.
• Drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, regulatory requirements, support, and risk management.
• Own the technical strategy for assigned customers - seeing across compute, storage, networking, security, data, and application domains to ensure they align and produce coherent outcomes.
• Define and maintain operational frameworks including DevSecOps practices, Operational Excellence standards, and Target Operating Models tailored to each customer's environment.
• Proactively keep customers' AWS environments operationally healthy through application-specific reviews proactive monitoring and custom runbooks.
• Use generative AI tools fluently to accelerate troubleshooting operational reviews and customer guidance and help customers adopt AWS generative AI services to modernize their operations.
• Leverage AI agents for workload discovery deep dive reviews and resilience assessments - reviewing and steering agent output to deliver actionable recommendations at pace.

About the team

If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon are seeking a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) to support our European Data Center infrastructure growth initiatives. Based in our Dublin or London corporate & Data Center offices, the TIPM will lead cross functional teams to drive the implementation and deployment of data center expansion projects to meet the demands of our rapidly growing business.

Our Technical Program Managers are strong communicators both written and verbally and lead multi-discipline, highly technical physical infrastructure project teams. They lead teams of internal and external stakeholders through all stages of the Data Center development lifecycle from initial site due diligence through Construction and into Operation. The core role of the TIPM is to deliver capacity for our customers through developing delivery programs and working closely with stakeholder teams to identify risks and resolve issues to ensure those programs are delivered on time and within budget.

The TIPM partners with various stakeholder teams during data center delivery; Real Estate to support the feasibility and selection of new sites; Energy to ensure suitable grid connection is available; Design Engineering to coordinate project specific inputs, constraints and risks into designs; Procurement to secure on time delivery of critical equipment; Construction Management to track budget & progress; and Operations to complete the project with successful handover, to name but a few.


In this role you will;
• Take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces,
• Clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal cross-functional and remote teams.
• Up to 25% travel is envisaged within EMEA. (Delivery TIPMs only)
• Be responsible for end-to-end program delivery from pre-contract design up to final handover to Operations of Colo, Hybrid Colo & AWS Leased/Owned Data Centers in the EMEA region.
• Manage interface between internal (Real Estate, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Infrastructure Deployment, Networking, Operations, Security, Fiber, Finance etc.) and external stakeholders (Contractors, Colo Vendors) to ensure on time and on budget delivery of Data Center projects.
• Build and maintaining overall delivery program and project budget, submitting Capital Allocation Requests to Senior leadership to secure finance for project delivery.
• Work with Capacity Planning, Energy and Real Estate teams to develop short & long term build strategies to meet forecast demand.
• Support continuous process improvement through leading workflow updates, documenting & implementing lessons learned and sharing knowledge across delivery teams to ensure EMEA wide efficiency improvements.
• Regularly report to senior leadership on status of key project metrics vs. commitment of your projects.

Delver critical capacity (DC builds) of high value at pace. Function in high ambiguity situations, engage stakeholder teams, and deal with senior level external stakeholders. Resolve complex technical and non-technical risks/issues/blockers. Take ownership of multi-build, cross region programs in parallel. Work with partners to shape cluster growth. What do you know about protecting sensitive data? What about fine-grained access control (FGAC) on Big Data? Or attribute-based access control (ABAC) and context based authorization?

What about catching bad actors that are abusing Amazon services? Or attacks that could potentially lead to a widespread data breach? Do you know how to generate activity-based intelligence (ABI) through anomaly detection?

In Security Products we build Access Policy Management systems to enable all Amazon teams to apply FGAC to their sensitive data. We build products that apply context based authorization to solve the problem of over-permissioning.

We apply Machine Learning Techniques in our Monitored Access (MA) abuse detection program to preemptively detect and mitigate internal and external malicious actors. We do this to protect Amazon customer, seller, vendor and employee information across from constantly changing abuse actor behaviors and patterns.

In our newly created organization we have a rare opportunity to engage with multiple Amazon organizations and groups of experienced tech leaders to build products with impact at an impressive scale (hundreds of thousands of services).

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the scoping and delivering of projects from end-to-end. You will be responsible for identifying the stakeholders, driving to set roadmaps and strategies for the program, driving delivery, reporting status, and holding the bar on product quality. You will handle complex inter-team dependencies and bridge the gaps in technical management. You will have the opportunity to learn about various Amazon business and technologies.

Our mission is to ensure that every ad impression delivered through Amazon's demand-side platform appears adjacent to content that meets advertiser trust expectations while giving brands granular controls to define suitability on their own terms. We operate at the intersection of advertiser trust, publisher quality, and supply integrity.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager who possesses stakeholder management, program management, and well-rounded technical capabilities. You will drive the execution of complex, cross-organizational programs that protect advertiser trust at scale - including vendor integrations, enhancing capabilities across evolving supply types such as CTV, audio and gaming. You will work across multiple teams with evolving priorities, define clarity where ambiguity exists, and make trade-offs to drive program delivery. As a Sr. TPM, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance business needs versus technical constraints. You will work across engineering, science, product, policy, legal, and external partners to deliver programs that directly impact advertiser confidence.

Key job responsibilities
Program Execution & Delivery
- Drive end-to-end execution across engineering and science teams
- Own delivery of cross-organizational initiatives
- Define program milestones, manage dependencies across all stakeholders, and drive teams to deliver on commitments
Technical Depth & Architecture Influence
- Understand the real-time ad serving infrastructure
- Evaluate technical proposals, identify risks in system design, and ensure appropriate trade-offs.
- Drive technical integration programs with third-party vendors.
- Partner with science teams on ML model deployment experimentation frameworks, and signal validation.
Stakeholder Management & Cross-Org Alignment
- Manage relationships and alignment across senior leaders and stakeholders
- Drive executive communications through monthly and quarterly updates, and escalate to leadership effectively as needed.
- Navigate competing priorities across advertiser protection, publisher relationships, and business growth imperatives
- Represent Brand Safety programs in cross-org forums
Operational Excellence
- Create mechanisms that ensure long-term program success with or without direct involvement — documentation, runbooks, audit trails
- Own program-level metrics and reporting for leadership visibility

A day in the life
You will work with cross functional stakeholders across engineering, product and data science leadership to define engineering and product strategy. You will deliver state of the art machine learning based technical solutions that will power several contextual advertising products across Amazon Ads.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon seeks a Senior Treasury Dealer to join the Treasury Strategy and Markets Team, which oversees global foreign exchange trading, commodities, and equities execution. This role sits at the heart of Amazon's trading operations, where you will be responsible for executing and managing multi-asset class trading strategies across FX, equities, and commodities markets. As a key member of the team, you will leverage trading platforms and analytics to drive efficient execution while ensuring best-in-class trading practices. The successful candidate should be comfortable with ambiguity and balancing multiple competing priorities, demonstrating strong decision-making capabilities in fast-paced market conditions. You will build and maintain strategic relationships with key banking counterparties and work cross-functionally across Amazon's diverse business lines to support the company's global trading needs.
This position requires a self-starter who will work to continuously improve Treasury processes while maintaining a rigorous control environment and compliance with various Amazon policies.

Key Responsibilities include:
• Execute foreign exchange, equity, rates, and commodity trades to support Amazon's global business operations
• Develop and maintain real-time monitoring of market conditions, liquidity, and pricing across multiple venues and counterparties to ensure optimal execution
• Implement best execution practices and conduct regular Transaction Cost Analysis (TCA) to optimize trading performance
• Create and monitor detailed reports that track the performance of execution metrics, including fill rates, rejection rates, and price improvements against internal KPIs
• Build and maintain relationships with key liquidity providers to ensure competitive pricing and market access across all asset classes
• Analyze market microstructure and implement algorithmic trading strategies to minimize market impact and improve execution efficiency
• Work with banking partners to develop and implement new execution methodologies for restricted currencies and emerging markets
• Collaborate with technology teams to enhance trading platforms, implement API connectivity, and automate execution processes
• Monitor trade settlement processes and resolve any trading-related issues with counterparties
• Work extensively with internal groups including Global Payments, Finance Operations, and Technology teams on trading infrastructure improvements
• Design and maintain trading dashboards that provide real-time visibility into execution performance, market conditions, and liquidity metrics
• Develop and document standard operating procedures for trading activities across all asset classes
• Participate in periodic reviews of counterparty performance and recommend changes to the counterparty panel as needed
• Stay current with market developments, regulatory changes, and new trading technologies that could impact execution strategies
• Conduct regular reviews of execution policies and procedures to ensure compliance with internal and external requirements

target_jobs.description:
Amazon is seeking a Indirect Tax Senior Manager to join the EMEA Tax Department based in London or in Luxembourg to support the Amazon Web Services (“AWS”) cloud computing business, focusing on VAT advisory.

The ideal candidate will be able to work with a high level of collegiality and independence, supporting AWS as it expands in EMEA and an increasing number of countries introduce legislation to bring within the scope of VAT supplies of “Electronically Supplied Services” or “Digital Services” rendered by non-residents.

Advising the AWS business will allow the candidate to be exposed to many jurisdictions in EMEA, as well as a variety of topics, including ESS, telecommunications, training, movements of goods, due diligence relating to acquisitions, launch of new products, etc. There will also be scope for dealing with local tax authorities through “horizontal monitoring” relationships, ad-hoc enquiries and during audits. The AWS Tax Team also works closely with tax authorities by participating to public consultations and workshops about new laws.


This role can be filled in London or Luxembourg.



Key job responsibilities
The role is to provide Indirect Tax support to the AWS Business Unit in EMEA. This includes primarily the AWS branded services (Cloud + Marketplace – www.aws.amazon.com). It also covers other entities within the “AWS Group”, such as Annapurna Labs, the AI chips designer.

The role will not focus solely on products / services sold by AWS and associated entities. We also advise on billing systems and supply chains, especially in relation to the AWS infrastructure (https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/), which forms the back-bone of the business – this includes the Data Centers and Points of Presence (known as “PoP”) Sites in EMEA (https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/regions_az/?p=ngi&loc=2), as well as the sustainability effort (https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/sustainability/).

The role involves:
1) Providing advice on new ventures and new products
2) Driving the tax requirements for AWS’ geographic expansion
3) Helping business find new solutions to problems raised / pain points by customers
4) Pro-actively communicating to business changes in law or new opportunities
5) Considering all aspects of business: Pricing, User Interface, Billing, Communication, FAQs, etc.
6) Supporting the supply infrastructure supply chain, from chips design, to server rack installation
7) Participating in public consultations on policy, including e-invoicing, to help shape the future of indirect taxation

The work by the team is very broad and allocation of projects is fluid: there are owners, but the team works together, to ensure good balance of workload and that all team members can see all areas of the business (instead of just “specializing” in one). The owner will not be required to “know it all”, but to drive the project and seek help/support from the team and other stakeholders (including outside advisers). The role will involve a wide geography exposure and broad range of offering:

1) AWS currently has a presence in over 40 countries in EMEA and keeps expanding
2) AWS is involved in Cloud Services, but also tangible goods (Data Centres) and hybrid offerings.

The role is 100% advisory: there is no compliance. However, we work closely with our compliance colleagues to support tax registrations, high-level review of tax returns, relationship with Tax Authorities, Management of Audits, internal reviews, process improvements, and training.


About the team
AWS offers a broad set of global cloud-based products including compute, storage, databases, analytics, networking, mobile, developer tools, management tools, Internet of Things, security and enterprise applications. These services help organizations move faster, lower IT costs, and scale. AWS is trusted by the largest enterprises and the hottest start-ups to power a wide variety of workloads including: web and mobile applications, game development, data processing and warehousing, storage, archive, and many others. AWS’ product page can be found here: https://aws.amazon.com/products/?nc2=h_ql_p.

In addition, AWS offers a variety of support services to help customers in deploying AWS services, as well as a comprehensive training and certification program. Finally, AWS also offers a Marketplace, enabling customers to locate, buy and immediately use digital products sold by third-party sellers.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon Shipping is building the future of parcel delivery for businesses across the EU. We pick up parcels directly from our shippers' facilities and deliver them to their end consumers using Amazon's world-class logistics network.
We're looking for a Shipper Experience Manager to own the operational relationship with a portfolio of shippers. You'll be the single point of contact from operations for your shippers within Amazon Shipping — their trusted advisor and their advocate internally. You'll onboard new shippers, drive performance across your portfolio, and ensure every shipper gets an exceptional level of service.
You'll drive alignment across partner teams, track actions to completion, and hold the network accountable for delivering results. You'll partner with Single Threaded Leaders, programme teams, and operational stakeholders to reduce costs, improve quality, and drive adoption of new capabilities with your shippers.
You'll need to be a supply chain subject matter expert who can translate complex operational realities into clear solutions for shippers. You'll visit shipper sites, host business reviews at all cadences, and use data and anecdotes to drive structural change internally. If you're energised by working at the intersection of customer experience and operational excellence, this is the role for you.
Our team is in a test-and-iterate phase — we're building new processes, refining our approach, and evolving quickly. You'll need to be highly flexible, comfortable with change, and able to adapt at pace as priorities shift and the function matures.


Key job responsibilities
Portfolio Management & Performance
• Own the operational relationship with a portfolio of shippers, acting as their single point of contact within Amazon Shipping
• Monitor shipper performance across quality metrics including On-Time Performance (OTP), non-conveyable rates, and damages
• Track and drive improvement in safety metrics including prohibited items compliance
• Identify trends, root causes, and opportunities using data — drive alignment with responsible teams and track corrective actions to completion
• Proactively identify risks to shipper performance before they materialise and drive mitigating actions
• Understand shipper volume forecasts and coordinate with the network on peak planning and capacity impact
• Understand commercial SLAs and ensure operational delivery against them, closing gaps with partner teams where needed
Shipper Onboarding
• Lead the operational onboarding of new shippers into the Amazon Shipping network
• Set shippers up for success with clear expectations, SLAs, and ongoing operational support
• Educate shippers on Amazon Shipping capabilities, processes, and best practices
Cross-Functional Partnership
• Partner with Single Threaded Leaders (e.g. First Mile Cost) to reduce costs and improve outcomes for your shippers
• Collaborate with programme teams to drive shipper adoption of new programmes and initiatives
• Provide shipper anecdotes and data to support OP1 intakes and strategic planning
Voice of Shipper
• Act as the voice of the shipper internally, ensuring your portfolio receives the right level of service
• Educate internal stakeholders on shipper needs and use real-world examples to drive structural change
• Visit shipper sites regularly to build relationships, understand their challenges, and identify opportunities
Business Reviews & Governance
• Host Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) to track performance and address operational issues
• Host Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) to review trends, initiative progress, and strategic alignment
• Host Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to present performance summaries, forward-looking plans, and recommendations

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. target_jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is building the world's most advanced satellite broadband network to deliver fast, affordable connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO), Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering reliable broadband to consumers, businesses, and government agencies globally.

The Consumer Europe team is responsible for bringing Amazon Leo to residential customers across the region through two channels: direct-to-consumer (B2C) and indirect-to-consumer (B2B2C). The indirect channel delivers Amazon Leo services through partnerships with telecommunications operators and internet service providers (ISPs) who own the customer relationship while leveraging Amazon Leo's technology infrastructure.

We are seeking a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to own the commercial performance and partner relationships across our European Consumer indirect portfolio. You will own the customer relationship across a number of Consumer indirect partnerships, primarily in Central Europe and Amazon's emerging European markets. This role is both strategic and operational; you will shape partner requirements, validate deals, support onboarding, and own the post-launch commercial relationship with accountability for revenue, customer experience, and long-term partner success. Beyond day-to-day partner management, you will help define how the regional indirect team operates; building mechanisms, establishing ways of working, and creating frameworks for scalable partner engagement across Europe.

This position may require access to export-controlled information (ECI) subject to EAR and ITAR. Final employment decision is contingent upon satisfactory completion of export control screenings and obtaining any necessary export licenses or approvals, based on nationality, citizenship, and other factors considered by applicable export control regulations.

Key job responsibilities
• Influence strategy for Amazon Leo with specific focus on indirect-to-consumer business (B2B2C)
• Drive partner performance through hands-on relationships with consumer distribution partners
• Track sell-through performance, identify growth opportunities, and ensure partners are executing against agreed business plans and targets
• Lead formal strategic meetings to review commercial performance, success metrics, and future goals
• Work with internal subject matter experts to gather information, synthesize business and concepts, build strategic business metrics, and write original content that drives decision-making at the highest levels of the organization
• Adept at thinking strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to build and convey compelling value propositions, and work cross-organizationally to build consensus

Our Program Manager's are always thinking about the bigger picture. Every position at Amazon offers the opportunity for employees to influence business decisions and shape the future. But as a Senior Program Manager, pioneering new ways of thinking, designing and delivering is your mission. Collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders across the business, you’ll continuously be scoping out new solutions. You’ll conduct your own research and analysis, always with an eye on the long-term vision of the business. This is your opportunity to have a big impact on some of the most exciting new ideas that are shaping the future of Amazon.

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract position.

Key job responsibilities
- Create innovative solutions using data and research to address wider challenges in your organization
- Take a big-picture approach in your analysis of business operations, driving improvements across a range of teams and organizations
- Work alongside senior leadership to establish and prioritize improvement programs, seeing them through from start to finish
- Enhance operational performance on every program in partnership with your stakeholders

A day in the life
As a Senior Program Manager, you’ll drive and manage the implementation of creative, data-driven change in Amazon, leading improvement projects and programs. You’ll use strategic thinking to define and implement an efficient project plan. Some managers are based on-site while others work remotely, depending on the most suitable option for their team and tasks.

Senior Program Managers have significant responsibilities, and you’ll deal with complex challenges with creativity, innovation, and leadership. With a responsibility extending beyond process improvements, you could also contribute to improving other areas of the business, like diversity, equity, and inclusion.

About the team
When you click on your screen, and know that your Amazon parcel will arrive with you on the next day, you’ve just use one of the world’s most sophisticated fulfillment networks. At AMZL Europe, we deliver millions of packages daily to customers at record speed and quality. The work that Launch and Expansion do is at the heart of that. Our relentless ambition is to make AMZL Europe more and more cost-effective and customer centric. We’re doing that by improving our existing network, inventing new and creative ways of making last-mile delivery more efficient, and optimizing the development of our Under the Roof and On Road Infrastructure. Within the team we have a variety of roles. Typical examples include program managers responsible for selecting and launching new sites, planners working out how we solve challenges such as low emission zones and EV charging, strategy teams looking at how we get the most out of our existing buildings, and analysts using data to deliver insights into how we work and how we should be working.

Help plan the future of the biggest last mile delivery network in Europe
Select, build and launch huge buildings and infrastructure with multi-million dollar budgets
Make decisions that shape Amazon’s fulfillment strategy across the globe
Work at the forefront of logistics innovation

your plans are what the network executes against.

- Own the EU5 Same Day HVE capacity planning process end-to-end: demand ingestion, gap identification, action tracking, and readiness sign-off

Senior Enterprise Sales Specialist, Cloud Infrastructure Retail

Do you obsess over customer outcomes?

We're looking for a Senior Enterprise Sales Specialist, Cloud Infrastructure who starts with the customer's business challenge, works backwards from their goals, and builds migration and modernisation solutions that deliver real, measurable value across the full AWS platform.

Join a team of driven sales specialists focused on helping UK and Ireland customers achieve transformational business outcomes through cloud migration and modernisation. You will earn trust by deeply understanding each customer's priorities, then build pipeline and close revenue by positioning migration not as a technology project but as the fastest path to the business results they care about.

The ideal candidate is a quota-carrying sales specialist who leads with customer empathy and backs it with technical credibility. You engage at CXO level to understand business pain, and propose solutions that genuinely solve problems. You see migration as the commercial catalyst for larger transformation programmes that culminate in AI adoption and intelligent automation, and you build pipeline by earning trust and demonstrating long-term value. You thrive in ambiguity, own outcomes end-to-end, and make decisions independently. You are a self-starter, ready to develop and execute account and territory plans that exceed targets. You bring strong knowledge of SaaS and on-premises infrastructure (Nutanix, VMware, Hyper-V), colocation and hosting environments, and cloud platforms (GCP, Azure), along with a working understanding of Microsoft licensing and enterprise agreements.

How you will spend your time

80% working directly with customers: understanding their business objectives, uncovering what success looks like for them, and designing the most effective path from migration through to full platform value on AWS.
20% creating campaigns and building thought leadership: developing strategic campaigns that generate net-new pipeline and establishing yourself as a trusted voice in your domain.
You will engage across the full transformation lifecycle:

Migrate: infrastructure landing and workload mobility
Modernise: application refactoring, containerisation, serverless adoption
Activate Data: analytics, lake formation, AI/ML readiness
Deploy Applications: GenAI, agentic workloads, intelligent automation
Your role is to find, build, and close opportunities across this lifecycle, always starting from the customer's desired outcomes and working backwards to the right solution.

Key job responsibilities
- Deeply understand customer business objectives, industry dynamics, and competitive pressures to identify where migration and modernisation can deliver the highest-impact outcomes.
- Generate and manage pipeline for AWS Migrations and Modernisations within defined verticals in the UK and Ireland, rooted in genuine customer need.
- Identify, qualify and close M&M deals from the largest, priority customers and targets in your verticals, positioning migration as the entry point to broader platform value that solves real business problems.
- Think Big: own the strategy to grow the migration and modernisation business in your territory. Design and execute campaigns, create new routes to market, and identify untapped customer segments or use cases that expand the addressable opportunity beyond today's pipeline.
- Drive thought leadership that tells the end-to-end transformation story: from migration through modernisation, data activation, and AI deployment. Create content, deliver keynotes, host executive roundtables, and build market awareness that positions AWS as the platform for customers building the company of the future.

- Build compelling commercial propositions that connect migration events with data modernisation, AI adoption, and agentic business transformation, always anchored to customer-defined success metrics.
- Position AI and GenAI as the outcome layer of migration: help customers see how moving to AWS unlocks access to services like Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, and partner AI technologies (e.g. Anthropic Claude) to drive competitive advantage post-migration.
- Own revenue targets across the full transformation lifecycle. Drive upsell and expansion by delivering on earlier promises and demonstrating measurable customer value at each stage.

- Leverage the AWS partner ecosystem to ensure customers get the right delivery support across large-scale migration and modernisation programmes.
- Respond to RFI/RFPs with differentiated, platform-level proposals that address what customers actually asked for, not generic capability decks.

Amazon’s Tax Services organization is building the next generation of solutions to shape the way that we calculate, collect and invoice tax information as one of the world’s largest collectors of online indirect taxes and fees. Our organization’s mission is to ensure that Amazon has the right technology and processes to remain accurate and adaptable in a rapidly changing business and tax environment.

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for a Sr Product Manager - Technical (Sr PM-T) to join us in London and help build the future of the Tax Services document printing product, which is responsible for generating billions of business-critical documents (e.g. tax invoices, commercial and transport documents) every year. As a Sr PM-T, you will be responsible for identifying and executing on opportunities to build high-impact solutions and features for our document printing product that meet customer needs and drive business growth.

We are looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial product manager who is passionate about solving complex and ambiguous problems, and who thrives in a fast-paced environment. This position has a high level of visibility, so you will need to be able to communicate clearly and compellingly at all levels of the company. Additionally, you will be responsible for measuring business impact by diving deep into metrics, tying inputs to business outcomes, and working backwards from customers. You should have a positive attitude and strong work ethic; you will work fast and smart, and adapt and iterate quickly. This role operates in highly ambiguous areas – ideal candidates have a proven track record of bringing clarity, simplifying and prototyping to iterate fast.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:

- Influence the development and execution of high-quality feature roadmaps based on the overall product strategy and vision.
- Understand and explain the impact of product features on the strategic value, useability and performance of the document printing product.
- Make prioritization and trade-off decisions among customer experience, scope, and time to market.
- Manage product planning and development through day-to-day collaboration and decision making with a cross-functional team including engineers, designers, and business development partner teams.
- Develop detailed, crisp user stories with acceptance criteria based on customer needs/experience and business requirements that can be used to create product specifications and architecture.
- Define and analyze metrics that measure and benchmark product success.

A day in the life
As a Sr PM-T in Tax Services, your day will be a mix of meetings and heads-down time for strategy and roadmap planning, and tactical execution. You’ll meet with customers and peers across product, engineering, UX, tax and legal to understand their needs and identify feature needs for our document printing product. You’ll develop functional product and user experience requirements for new features and processes to help meet our customer needs. You will be expected to own the end-to-end roadmap for discrete product features from requirements gathering through to implementation, working across teams to break down silos and drive feature delivery on the product. You will partner closely with the Tax Services engineering team to drive technology design outcomes that are scalable to support all of Amazon’s business and compliance needs. The work you deliver has a direct impact on the future portfolio of product for the Tax Services organization.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon’s Tax Services organization is building the next generation of solutions to shape the way that we calculate, collect and invoice tax information as one of the world’s largest collectors of online indirect taxes and fees. Our organization’s mission is to ensure that Amazon has the right technology and processes to remain accurate and adaptable in a rapidly changing business and tax environment.

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for a Sr Product Manager - Technical (Sr PM-T) to join us and help build the future of the Tax Services Entity Management product charter, which is responsible for collecting and validating tax data for Amazon and non-Amazon entities used across billions of tax calculations and documents every year. As a Sr PM-T, you will be responsible for identifying and executing on opportunities to build high-impact solutions and features for our Entity Management product that meet customer needs and drive business growth.

We are looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial product manager who is passionate about solving complex and ambiguous problems, and who thrives in a fast-paced environment. This position has a high level of visibility, so you will need to be able to communicate clearly and compellingly at all levels of the company. Additionally, you will be responsible for measuring business impact by diving deep into metrics, tying inputs to business outcomes, and working backwards from customers. You should have a positive attitude and strong work ethic; you will work fast and smart, and adapt and iterate quickly. This role operates in highly ambiguous areas – ideal candidates have a proven track record of bringing clarity, simplifying and prototyping to iterate fast.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:

- Influence the development and execution of high-quality feature roadmaps based on the overall product strategy and vision.
- Understand and explain the impact of product features on the strategic value, useability and performance of the document Entity Management product.
- Make prioritization and trade-off decisions among customer experience, scope, and time to market.
- Manage product planning and development through day-to-day collaboration and decision making with a cross-functional team including engineers, designers, and business development partner teams.
- Develop detailed, crisp user stories with acceptance criteria based on customer needs/experience and business requirements that can be used to create product specifications and architecture.
- Define and analyze metrics that measure and benchmark product success.

A day in the life
As a Sr PM-T in Tax Services, your day will be a mix of meetings and heads-down time for strategy and roadmap planning, and tactical execution. You’ll meet with customers and peers across product, engineering, UX, tax and legal to understand their needs and identify feature needs for our Entity Management product. You’ll develop functional product and user experience requirements for new features and processes to help meet our customer needs. You will be expected to own the end-to-end roadmap for discrete product features from requirements gathering through to implementation, working across teams to break down silos and drive feature delivery on the product. You will partner closely with the Tax Services engineering team to drive technology design outcomes that are scalable to support all of Amazon’s business and compliance needs. The work you deliver has a direct impact on the future portfolio of product for the Tax Services organization.

Want to build something that actually moves the needle — at Amazon scale? The Last Mile DSP Payments team is looking for a Sr Program lead who doesn't just want a seat at the table, but wants to roll up their sleeves and rebuild the table itself.

We move more than €1B a year across 9 countries, 2,000+ legal entities, and 37,000+ service rate combinations — today, a lot of that runs on semi-automated workflows, Excel files, and cross-functional muscle memory. That's exactly the opportunity: if you're the kind of person who sees a messy, high-stakes process and immediately starts sketching the fix, this is your playground. You'll be hands-on from day one, with real ownership over how hundreds of Delivery Service Partners get paid across Europe.

This isn't a role for someone who wants a fully paved roadmap. It's for someone who wants to build the road.

Key job responsibilities
What You'll Do
Own and drive payment process improvement initiatives across EU manual and semi-automated workstreams — fleet, fuel, incentives, and beyond
Strengthen and build new financial controls and audit trails — find the gaps before they become problems
Build Excel-based tools, models, and dashboards (pivot tables, Power Query, macros, VBA) that replace manual grind with scalable systems
Chase down payment discrepancies across EU countries — trace the data, find the root cause, fix it, and make sure it doesn't come back
Turn messy operational reality into clean, structured requirements that fuel automation with Last Mile Payments Tech
Help shape and execute the DSP payment automation roadmap, working shoulder-to-shoulder with Finance, Tax, Fleet, Pricing, and Tech

A day in the life
- You're an Excel power user — pivot tables, Power Query, and macro/VBA automation are second nature (we'll put this to the test)
- You bring order to chaos — structured thinking that turns ambiguity into a clear plan, fast
- You communicate with energy and clarity — across functions, across geographies, up to leadership and down to the front line
- You learn fast and don't wait to be told twice — complex payment logic, regulatory nuance, and cross-functional dependencies are puzzles you enjoy solving
- You're up for travel — getting in the room with EU regional ops teams, on-site, is part of how you get things done
- You thrive under pressure — peak periods with serious financial stakes don't rattle you, they energize you

**Bonus points for:** AI skills, SQL, BI tools (QuickSight, Tableau), experience with offshore teams, or a second European language

About the team
Our team is focused on delivering programs that improve the experience for our customers while driving operational excellence across the business. We value collaboration, clear thinking, and a willingness to roll up our sleeves to get things done. As we continue to grow, we are investing in new mechanisms and scalable solutions that will shape how we operate in the years ahead. You will join an inclusive group of program managers who support each other, challenge ideas constructively, and take pride in delivering results that matter.

Amazon Shipping is seeking a Senior Content Program Manager to own our end-to-end content strategy across client-facing and internal support channels. You will design a comprehensive content framework covering SOPs, help documentation, policy updates, and new product launches, ensuring every piece is accurate, accessible, and built for the audiences it serves. You will benchmark against industry leaders, establish measurable goals to track content quality and effectiveness, and hold cross-functional stakeholders across technology, legal, marketing, operations, and commercial teams accountable to their deliverables. A core part of this mandate is reducing support escalations by ensuring clear, actionable answers are available before a contact is ever created.

Content is the foundation of our AI strategy, and this role sits at the center of that vision. Every help article, SOP, and policy document developed here will feed directly into our AI tools, powering personalized, context-aware summaries and real-time guidance for associates managing complex support cases. You will define the taxonomy, structure, and quality standards that make content machine-readable and AI-ready, ensuring our models surface the right information at the right moment. Beyond written content, you will lead the development of interactive video experiences that translate complex operational topics into simple, intuitive formats that drive self-service adoption.

The ideal candidate brings a combination of analytical rigor and creative vision: someone who can build a content measurement framework from scratch, identify gaps through data, and translate ambiguous business needs into structured, scalable programs. You thrive in fast-moving environments, communicate with clarity across all levels of the organization, and understand that great content is not just well-written but strategically designed to move metrics. If you are energized by building something meaningful from the ground up and want your work to directly shape how thousands of shippers experience Amazon, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and own the end-to-end content strategy, building a scalable framework that covers SOPs, help documentation, policy changes, and new product launches for both external clients and internal support associates
- Benchmark content quality and effectiveness against industry leaders, define measurable goals, and establish review mechanisms to track performance and drive continuous improvement
- Lead cross-functional program management across technology, legal, marketing, operations, and commercial teams; define milestones, track progress, and hold stakeholders accountable to individual deliverables
- Define the taxonomy, structure, and quality standards that make content machine-readable and AI-ready, ensuring our tools surface accurate, personalized, and context-aware information at the right moment

In this role, you will be part of the team that ensures AWS's supply chain can deliver the datacenter racks, servers, and networking equipment to our datacenters across the globe. We are the jack-of-all-trades with the best understanding of how the entire end-to-end supply chain works and how to help it run better.

This is a senior-level Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) role, responsible for building and executing AWS's Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) program and serves as the vital tactical link to our centralized corporate Trade, Tax, and Compliance organizations. This is a high-judgment role, where you will represent the AWS supply chain during engagements with public sector customers, and must be able to translate customer and regulatory requirements into actionable deliverables, determine what is a true requirement versus a nice-to-have, and understand how to find the balance between cybersecurity and business objectives.

The ideal candidate is a technically savvy individual leader, capable of leveraging AWS's internal business and artificial intelligence tool to gather data and identify risks before they become problems, as well as interact with both internal and external senior leaders to gain support for new initiatives and obtain consensus with AWS customers.

You will be responsible for identifying, creating, and delivering on your initiatives and must have both excellent interpersonal and writing skills to work across myriad teams in the supply chain, security, and legal organizations to deliver results in an ambiguous operating environment. It will be your responsibility to ensure the supply chain delivers on our security and risk management commitments to our customers, as well as make sure region build and operational teams are able to get the infrastructure hardware they need when they need it.

This position requires that the selected candidate already be a UK citizen and, after starting, obtain the commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Driving consensus and standardization for acceptable levels of risk and best practices across supply chain operations
- Developing technical solutions that drive automation at scale to ensure datacenter infrastructure is delivered on-time, in-full
- Proactively working with other organizations to anticipate gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures, influencing where no formal reporting structures exist
- Articulating in writing (actual papers, not slides) key issues and strategic initiatives for senior leadership
- Acting as a thought and business leader in the field of cybersecurity, supply chain risk management, and supply chain operations

A day in the life
You are at the intersection of the Venn diagram for security, operations, and risk management, and thus work with a variety of different stakeholders. You will primarily focus on addressing supply chain security and risk concerns for UK-based public sector customers to allow the supply chain to operate smoothly, but the team supports our global footprint and you will collaborate with international peers to drive standardization and scalable practices across the global supply chain.

Our team has the greatest end-to-end view and understanding of AWS's supply chain and sits at the center of the Venn diagram of supply chain security, operations, and risk management. About Amazon Ads

Amazon Ads is the digital advertising arm of Amazon and one of our fastest growing businesses. We operate at the intersection of commerce, entertainment and advertising. Amazon Ads offers unique advertising products, enterprise ad tech and a rich array of unique creative, format and measurement solutions. We believe that advertising, when done well, can connect the right brands with the right consumers while delivering holistic value.

Twitch is the world's leading live-streaming platform, home to a highly engaged, hard-to-reach audience that spends billions of minutes each month watching gaming, entertainment, sports, music and creator-led content. As Twitch continues to scale its advertising proposition across EMEA, the ability to articulate the unique value of Twitch audiences to advertisers is a critical growth lever - and a capability we are building from the ground up.

This is an individual contributor role embedded within the Twitch Go-to-Market (GTM) team who will focus on Insights and Measurement. You will work extensively with the Twitch sales specialists, GTM leads, product and ad-tech teams to develop and deliver insights that directly fuel revenue growth.

This is not a backend role. You will actively participate in customer meetings as the subject matter expert on Twitch audience insights & measurement, and leverage Amazon's rich array of insights and measurement solutions - combined with Twitch-native data - to deliver media strategies that position Twitch as an essential part of the advertising mix.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the Twitch insights playbook from scratch: Develop a scalable library of Twitch audience insights, competitive benchmarks and measurement case studies that the sales team can deploy across pitches, QBRs and strategic conversations.

- Equip the sales team to sell with confidence: Translate complex Twitch audience data (viewership, engagement, demographics, content affinities) into clear, compelling narratives that articulate the unique and incremental value of Twitch to advertisers.

- Establish and advance senior-level relationships: Build relationships with senior marketing decision makers (e.g. Senior Director, C-level) by positioning yourself as the go-to expert on Twitch audience intelligence and at least one advanced analytical area of advertising.

- Generate data-driven insights: Leverage Amazon's proprietary data, Twitch-native signals, third-party research and ad measurement solutions to generate actionable insights that prove the impact of advertising on Twitch.

- Develop Twitch measurement expertise: Develop expertise in Twitch-specific metrics and Amazon's proprietary measurement tools, working to constantly evolve how we analyse and communicate the value of Twitch audiences to advertisers.

- Directly support revenue growth: Partner with GTM and sales leadership to identify the highest-impact insight gaps, prioritise your roadmap accordingly, and measure your work against pipeline and revenue outcomes.

- Advocate for data-driven decision-making: Guide advertisers to implement recommended solutions, with a particular focus on demonstrating Twitch's role in full-funnel and cross-platform strategies.

- Influence product and go-to-market strategy: Write internal documents with strategic recommendations that influence the direction of Twitch advertising products, measurement capabilities and go-to-market working mechanisms with internal stakeholders.

- Scale your analyses: Actively scale your analyses to other categories or locales through AI-native solutions.



A day in the life
No two days at Amazon are the same. You will have the flexibility to work with your stakeholders and define a book of business that will maximise your impact on Twitch revenue. On any given day, you might find yourself:
- Building a bespoke audience profile to help a seller win a competitive brief in colaboration with our Audience&Insights organization
- Presenting Twitch viewership insights at a sales-led event or advertiser summit
- Partnering with the GTM team to shape the narrative for a tentpole moment like TwitchCon

Amazon Ads is the digital advertising arm of Amazon and one of our fastest growing businesses. We operate at the intersection of commerce, entertainment and advertising, offering unique advertising products (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display), enterprise ad tech (Amazon DSP, Amazon Ad Server, Amazon Marketing Cloud, Amazon Publisher Services) and a rich array of unique creative, format and measurement solutions. We offer advertisers premium brand placements on our owned and operated properties, including Thursday Night Football, FreeVee, Prime Video, Twitch, and FireTV as well as on third-party publishers via Amazon Publisher Services.

We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including in advertising. We believe that advertising, when done well, enhances the customer experience with delightful discovery for consumers and compelling performance for advertisers. The insights we deliver to advertisers and their partners enable them to build unique connection with consumers, from first discovery to loyalty in a unique and compelling way versus any other media platform at scale.

We seek a seasoned professional to join us as Sr. GTM Lead, Twitch Ads UK & EU5. This role will be responsible for developing the unified go-to-market strategy and strategic execution for advertising solutions across all Twitch properties for the UK market, while also driving cross-EU5 initiatives to accelerate regional revenue growth and advertiser adoption. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a fast-growing and entrepreneurial organization, bringing innovation and growing adoption of Twitch Ads in the UK and across Europe. We are seeking an innovative, creative, analytical and strategic thinker, who is passionate about digital media and the future of Twitch advertising in the UK and EU5 markets. The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex problems, works effectively with cross-functional teams and thrives in a fast-paced setting that is constantly evolving. This role will be highly visible with senior levels of Amazon, and will need to work collaboratively with internal management teams to understand where our relative advantages or risks lie within the UK market and across EU5, where new market segments and solutions should be created. The successful candidate will have a talent for responding effectively to UK and European industry direction, customer needs and market positioning. They are comfortable with ambiguity and juggling multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced dynamic environment. They possess high levels of creativity, independence, flexibility and attention to detail. In addition, this person will be a unique thinker who can make convincing, information-based arguments.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive end-to-end GTM strategy for Twitch advertising offerings in the UK, while also contributing to cross-EU5 strategic initiatives to accelerate regional revenue growth and advertiser adoption
- Maintain deep understanding of UK and European video, display, social media and influence advertising landscape, including market trends, competitive analysis, and cultural nuances across EU5 markets

- Provide strategic support and guidance for Twitch Ads initiatives in the UK and across EU5 markets
- Proven analytical and strategic thinking capabilities with proven track record in digital advertising
- Fluency in English required; additional European language skills are a plus
