AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.

- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.

- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.

- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.

- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.

- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

In this role, you'll work across the full software development lifecycle — from understanding the problem, through design and implementation, to testing, deployment, and operations. You'll tackle problems where the business need is clear but the right technical solution still needs to be shaped, and you'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on how security scales across some of Amazon's most exciting entertainment products.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain security tools, automations, and services that support ATG's media businesses, delivering working software across the full development lifecycle including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
- Collaborate with security engineers and partner engineering teams across Music, Audible, and Games to understand requirements and deliver solutions that address real security challenges.
- Identify opportunities to improve existing systems and processes, balancing short-term needs with long-term architectural goals while keeping solutions simple and maintainable.
- Write clear documentation for the software you build — covering what it does, how it's constructed, and how it fits into the broader security landscape — and actively coach teammates through code reviews.

excluded_nonbusiness_jobs.description:
The Data Center Builder Tools team is looking for an innovative, self-directed Software Development Engineer to build the next generation of real-time middleware and runtime software that powers industrial control systems across AWS Data Centers worldwide. Contribute to Amazon's vision of developing the safest, most secure, reliable, and efficient data centers on Earth.


As a Software Development Engineer II (SDE II) on this team, you will design and build the software that sits between industrial hardware and the cloud — a unified, real-time data plane that lets control applications, device drivers, and cloud services exchange data reliably on industrial computing hardware. This is deep systems work: you will shape the runtime, the communication layer, and the protocol integrations that everything else in the platform is built on.


In this role you will:
Design and build real-time middleware and runtime components — the data-exchange layer, type system, and communication patterns (publish/subscribe and request/reply) that connect distributed control applications across languages and hardware.

Integrate with industrial automation platforms and hardware protocols (e.g. IEC 61131-3, EtherCAT, PROFINET, Modbus, OPC-UA, IO-Link) and the device drivers that bridge them onto the platform.

Build the bridge to the cloud — reliable metric publication, command handling, and telemetry from the edge into AWS, with the right delivery guarantees for each data class.

Work at the boundary of distributed and real-time systems, where correctness means both the right result and the right timing — bounded latency, predictable behavior, and graceful degradation when connectivity is lost.

Partner with a cross-functional team of hardware engineers, controls engineers, data center operations, and security specialists to take features from design through to hardware validation.

If you're excited by low-level systems, real-time data movement, and connecting physical equipment to the cloud at scale, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
As an SDE II on this team, you will own the design and delivery of the runtime and middleware components at the core of the platform. This is a hands-on building role with significant technical ownership and accountability over how the system moves and models data.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

Architecting and implementing runtime and real-time middleware — high-performance, low-latency components that run both on embedded/edge controllers and in the cloud, with a focus on determinism, reliability, and resource efficiency on constrained hardware.

Building industrial protocol and hardware integrations — extending the platform with new device drivers and protocol support and solving the hard problems of cross-language, cross-platform data exchange (type systems, serialization, memory layout, and schema/versioning).

Owning the edge-to-cloud communication path — designing how telemetry, metrics, and commands flow between devices and AWS services with appropriate quality-of-service, backpressure, and store-and-forward behavior.

Engineering for real-time correctness — reasoning about latency budgets, throughput, and failure modes in a distributed system where the software is adjacent to physical control loops.

Raising the engineering bar — driving strong testing (unit, integration, and on-hardware validation), performance benchmarking, code review, and operational excellence for the components you own.

Collaborating across disciplines—working with hardware, controls, security, and operations partners to turn ambiguous requirements into robust, shippable software.

Mentoring and contributing to technical direction — guiding more junior engineers and helping shape the roadmap for the runtime and middleware layer.

The ideal candidate has a strong systems-software background and experience across several of the following: real-time or embedded systems, industrial automation platforms and hardware protocols, distributed systems, middleware/messaging (pub/sub, RPC), and cloud communication. You are comfortable working close to the metal, memory, concurrency, and serialization timing and equally comfortable reasoning about how edge components integrate with cloud services. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to correctness in the face of hardware and timing constraints, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment are essential. Experience with Rust, C/C++, or Python, and with technologies such as Industrial automation platforms, OPC-UA, DDS/Zenoh or similar real-time middleware, is a strong advantage.

A day in the life
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

About the team
The Data Center Builder Tools team develops tooling for device frameworks, and device lifecycle management in AWS Data Centers. This includes both frontend and backend services use by internal development teams and on-site customers. Our tools power the industrial controls systems deployed in our data centers.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

As a Solutions Architect I at Amazon, you will partner directly with customers to design and deliver cloud-based solutions that reduce risk, optimize costs, and unlock new possibilities. • Serve as the technical point of contact for new-to-cloud public sector customers in the UK guiding them from first workload to production.

• Build repeatable plays and enablement assets for common customer scenarios (cost optimization, compliance, legacy migration).

This is a builder-first technical role that combines the strategic advisory expertise of a Solutions Architect with hands-on software engineering capabilities.

Build working prototypes in customer non-production sandbox environments using AI-augmented development tools — delivering tangible, demonstrable value early in the engagement
Pair-program with customer teams, embedding directly with their engineers during time-boxed sprints to accelerate AI adoption and cloud-native development

Own the end-to-end technical relationship with Tier-1 European telco groups, acting as trusted advisor to technical decision makers
Shape AI and cloud strategy for major operators — translating complex technical capabilities into business-outcome narratives

Identify and launch new opportunities discovered during customer engagements
Increase service adoption per customer through tangible demonstrations of multi-service integration
Customer Development Engineer Operating Principles

Outcome-focused — identify, develop, and realise business opportunities through tangible proof points
Security first, speed second — but both are possible — AI-augmented development compresses timelines without compromising security or architectural integrity

Are you an expert in the dynamic field of inventory management? Amazon is seeking a passionate and experienced professional to take on the role of Spare Parts Inventory Manager. In this position, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the global strategy for spare parts inventory management within the Central Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) Integrated Spare Parts (ISP) team, with a specific focus on the logistics and carrier framework that makes the nodal network work.
This position goes beyond traditional inventory management. It requires an expert who can influence and transform how Amazon RME manages spare parts inventory on a global scale. You will not only oversee stock levels but also lead process improvement projects, such as enhancing parts traceability and optimizing inventory workflows to reduce waste and improve availability. The nodal model only delivers if parts move reliably between sites, which makes transportation a structural prerequisite rather than an afterthought. In this role you will support the definition of the criteria used to select and evaluate logistics vendors, contribute to those evaluations, and help shape the service agreements that follow in collaboration with procurement teams.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive initiatives to ensure the right spare parts are available at the right locations, minimizing costs while maximizing operational efficiency
- Support the development and execution of the nodal spare parts strategy, defining how sites reallocate stock efficiently to reduce inventory holdings while improving parts availability
- Support nodal cluster expansion activities, including site onboarding, launch readiness criteria, and defining operational standards for how nodes receive, store, pick, and ship inventory
- Define the requirements for the carrier framework used to move spare parts across the nodal network, including the selection matrix, regional coverage, service modes, agreed service levels, and the scorecard used to manage carrier performance.
- Define the standards for shipment execution, packaging, and inbound receipt so parts travel safely and are correctly recorded on arrival, and own the escalation path and the operating documentation that supports the field
- Support initiatives to maintain and improve spare parts data integrity, ensuring accurate cataloging, sourcing attributes, and lifecycle information to enable effective purchasing and inventory decisions
- Conduct data analysis and effectively interpret reports to identify opportunities, optimize processes, and implement changes
- Lead and champion complex, cross-functional process improvement projects, deprecating redundant workflows and implementing best practices that improve the tracking, accuracy, and efficiency of spare parts management with global impact

Define, document, communicate and own mechanical and plumbing engineering design standards.

Tracking key metrics and performance

Functioning as consulting SME to stakeholders

Working across the industry to understand trends and develop scalable technologies

Develop, cultivate, and manage relationships with third-party engineering consultants. Track and manage quality and cost of consultant work product.

Work cross functionally with other Amazon physical retail business groups to share and develop best practices and lessons learned.

Amazon's Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) organization is seeking a Senior Product Manager - Technical to own the product strategy and roadmap for OmniFrost, Amazon's next-generation SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) platform. OmniFrost is a mobile-first, AI-powered monitoring and control system designed to replace both legacy vendor SCADA and Amazon's existing SCADA 2.0 across the global
fulfilment network.

This role owns the end-to-end product lifecycle for OmniFrost from defining requirements and success metrics through scaled network deployment. You will work directly with RME field teams,engineering, and leadership to drive a production-ready platform that delivers measurable operational impact at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and own the OmniFrost product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap covering pilot validation through network-wide deployment across technically feasible sites globally
- Establish measurable KPIs tied to business outcomes: MTTR improvement, system availability, user adoption, alarm latency, and technician satisfaction (NPS)
- Define deployment requirements across CF, AMZL, and ATS business types spanning NA and EU regions, covering diverse SCADA configurations and equipment vendors (Vanderlande, Dematic, Amazon ARS)
- Drive feature prioritization across core capabilities: interactive 2D/3D layouts, AI-assisted triage (Graph RAG-based smart recommendations), live camera feeds, command and control, native APM integration, and multi-device access
- Design experimental methodology including matched-pair control sites and measurement frameworks to prove OmniFrost delivers incremental value beyond existing solutions
- Own Go/No-Go criteria for scale deployment based on validated pilot results
- Partner with Spectralink/DeFrost team on deployment automation economics targeting significant reduction in retrofit time and cost
- Coordinate with Quattro, COSMOS, BiFrost, APM, and OEE engineering teams on technical dependencies and integration requirements
- Represent RME customer needs in architectural decisions for AI-assisted triage, agentic AI (MCP protocol), alarm consolidation, and mobile-first design
- Manage stakeholder alignment across RME field leadership, GES, ELM, Controls Engineering, and executive steering committees

About the team
The Controls Engineering (CE) team within Central RME builds and deploys Amazon's internal SCADA platform across the global fulfilment network. We provide real-time equipment monitoring and control capabilities to RME technicians across sites in North America, Europe, LATAM, and Asia-Pacific.

Our mission is to eliminate dependency on third-party vendor SCADA systems, reduce equipment downtime through proactive monitoring (proven 44% MTTR reduction), and deliver unified visibility across all equipment vendors. OmniFrost represents the next generation — built on a React-based, Ignition-free architecture with AI-powered guidance, self-service deployment automation, and native APM integration.

The team operates at the intersection of industrial automation, software engineering, and AI/ML — building real-time web applications, data pipelines (Kinesis, COSMOS), spatial intelligence platforms
(Spectralink), and agentic AI systems (Graph RAG, MCP protocol). This is a high-impact team with outsized influence on Amazon's operational efficiency across the fulfilment network.

This role is based in Europe with global scope, reporting to the Sr. Development Manager for Amazon SCADA/OmniFrost.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Real Estate Development Manager to join the Real Estate Development Management (REDM) team within Data Centre Supply Solutions (DCSS) EMEA. Based in London, this role carries responsibility for managing the full lifecycle of data centre developments across EMEA — with assignments spanning the United Kingdom, Ireland, and additional regions as to meet business need.

The REDM function exists because data centre land acquisitions are not simple property transactions. Each development requires complex planning and zoning entitlements navigated through local regulatory frameworks, infrastructure obligations negotiated with statutory authorities, performance bonds managed over multi-year delivery programmes, sustained relationships with Authorities Having Jurisdiction, and coordination across a dozen internal stakeholder teams. Without a Single-Threaded Owner, accountability fragments, decisions drift, costs escalate, and programmes delay.

You will be that owner. You will exercise strategic and commercial judgement across complex, high-value development programmes. You will define and execute strategy with limited guidance, influence outcomes across organisations and geographies, and take end-to-end accountability for the developments assigned to you — from the first introduction of an opportunity through to close-out.

Travel: Regular travel across EMEA

About the Team

The REDM function sits within DCSS EMEA and serves as the Single-Threaded Owner for the development management of all Hybrid, Build-to-Suit (BTS), and Owned Land developments across the region. The team currently manages approximately 60 developments with an aggregated Capital Approval value exceeding $14 billion, spanning 9 regions across EMEA.

The team comprises in-country real estate development professionals positioned across key EMEA markets — including the UK, Germany, Spain, Italy, France, and Ireland — each bringing deep local expertise, regulatory knowledge, and established AHJ relationships in their respective jurisdictions. The function holds a broad and expanding mandate: Single-Threaded Ownership of all Hybrid and BTS development agreements, all Collateral Development Obligations (CDO) and Supporting Public Infrastructure (SPI) on land acquisitions, and all site development permitting from pre-acquisition through to Adoption/Taken-In-Charge (ATIC) and release of securities.

You will join a high-performing, internationally diverse team and work directly with counterparts in Business Development, Design Engineering, Pre-Construction, Construction, Legal, Finance, Environmental, Power, Water, and Public Policy.

The Role

Senior REDMs operate as the development owner — not as a support function, an advisor, or a coordinator. You will be the single point of authority and accountability for every development assigned to you, with the mandate to act on behalf of AWS and the judgement to know when to escalate.

The scope of the role spans three interconnected domains. In practice, you will be working across all three simultaneously:

Development Agreement Management

You will be the STO for Hybrid and BTS development agreements from pre-transaction through to close-out. In the pre-transaction phase, you will provide expert development management input to deal negotiations — shaping the commercial structure, specifications, cost arrangements, risk allocation, and change control provisions that will govern the development. Post-transaction, you will take ownership of delivering against the terms of the agreement: establishing the Development Business Plan, managing costs against approved budgets, managing the counterparty relationship, chairing progress meetings, preparing monthly development reports, and identifying and resolving adverse impacts before they crystallise into programme delay or cost overrun.

You own the budget and the delivery date. You are the only party authorised to instruct change. You exercise commercial judgement daily — on cost challenges, counterparty claims, specification queries, and programme risks — and you are accountable for the outcomes.

Land Development & Permitting

You will lead the entire site development permitting process for land acquisitions in your assigned regions — from the earliest point a land opportunity is introduced, through planning and zoning, CDO/SPI delivery, and onwards to ATIC of completed works and release of securities.

This is where the role demands local expertise. Site development permitting is deeply rooted in local regulation, planning law, and political stakeholder dynamics. It requires you to build and maintain sustained relationships with local planning authorities and government bodies; navigate zoning, planning, and building permit processes with confidence and authority; represent AWS directly before AHJs as the landowner — not through intermediaries; negotiate development obligations, planning agreements, and urban development contracts; and develop permitting and phasing strategies that protect the critical path to capacity delivery.

Your portfolio may include developments across multiple jurisdictions, each with its own regulatory framework. You will be expected to navigate these differences with the adaptability, cultural awareness, and local engagement that the role demands.

Stakeholder Leadership & Cross-Functional Coordination

The REDM sits at the centre of a complex stakeholder ecosystem. Externally, you will manage counterparties, AHJs, local elected officials, statutory undertakers, community stakeholders, and external consultants. Internally, you will coordinate across Business Development, Design Engineering, Pre-Construction, Construction, Legal, Environmental, Power, Water, and Public Policy to ensure strategic and consistent messaging on development goals and priorities.

You will take the central role in strategy and decision-making on all development matters. You will establish the collaboration model with Design Engineering — where DE defines what the Data Centre requires from the site, and you define how to secure those conditions through local processes. You will maintain Memoranda of Understanding with Pre-Construction on infrastructure categorisation and actively lead escalations through the organisation when alignment is not achieved at working level.

What Success Looks Like

Our incumbent Senior REDMs set the benchmark for this role. Across the team, successful performance is characterised by:

Owning a multi-site portfolio of developments worth hundreds of millions of dollars, managing each as an integrated programme with full commercial and programme accountability.

Building and leading the AHJ engagement strategy in-country — establishing direct, senior-level relationships with planning authorities, meeting regularly with council officers and elected representatives, and being recognised as the AWS voice in the room.

Identifying and surfacing material cost savings against approved investment decisions through rigorous analysis of development agreements and obligations.

Leading complex permitting processes end-to-end — including zoning modifications, full planning applications, environmental assessment processes, and planning obligation negotiations.

Establishing the REDM function from the ground up in a new country or region, becoming the coordination hub for the entire development portfolio in that geography.

Developing and owning urban development contracts, inter-administrative agreements, and territorial agreements with municipalities and regional governments.

Driving strategic permitting pathway decisions at critical gates — evaluating alternative routes, recommending approaches, and managing risk where the regulatory environment is uncertain or contested.

Protecting capacity delivery by identifying and mitigating development risks proactively — including regulatory challenge risk, AHJ capacity constraints, design misalignment, and third-party dependencies.

Contributing to the evolution of the REDM function through development of tools, mechanisms, and reporting frameworks that raise the standard across the team.

A day in the life
Infrastructure Services (AIS) AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, AWS

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fuelled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

excluded_nonbusiness_jobs.description:
Are you a customer-obsessed builder with a passion for helping customers achieve their full potential? Do you have the technical background, customer experience, and skills necessary to help accelerate customer adoption of Amazon Connect's AI capabilities? Do you love building new strategic and data-driven businesses? Join the Applied AI Solutions team as an Amazon Connect Specialist Solutions Architect!

The Applied AI Solutions Architecture team is seeking a hands-on, customer-obsessed Solutions Architect to accelerate customer adoption of Amazon Connect's AI capabilities. Applied AI Solutions is part of the AWS Specialist & Partner (ASP) org, which works backwards from our customer’s most complex and business critical problems to build and execute go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. We pride ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional results for our customers, and working across AWS as #OneTeam.

A critical dimension of this role is Customer Data Readiness — assessing, preparing, and structuring customer data assets so that AI agents can reliably access, retrieve, and act on the right information. You will help customers evaluate their data landscape, identify gaps, establish data pipelines, and ensure their knowledge bases, CRMs, and backend systems are AI-ready before agents go live. You will work at the intersection of contact center operations and applied AI, helping customers move from proof-of-concept to pre-production for their Amazon Connect deployments. We stay closely connected to our customers and bring valuable data and insights to our product teams, strengthening the product roadmap. Our team is at its best when a customer is thinking big and needs specialized experience to innovate for their business.

Key job responsibilities
* Customer Engagement: Lead technical discovery sessions with customer teams to understand business requirements, existing contact center architecture, and AI readiness. Translate findings into actionable implementation plans.
* Customer Data Readiness: Conduct data readiness assessments to evaluate the quality, accessibility, structure, and governance of customer data assets (CRMs, knowledge bases, ticketing systems, order management, etc.). Identify data gaps, recommend remediation strategies, and help customers build the data foundation required for effective AI agent tool use and RAG-powered responses.
* Agentic AI Implementation: Design and configure agentic AI solutions within Amazon Connect, including AI agent creation, AI prompt engineering, model selection, guardrail configuration, and tool/action integration.
* A2A (Agent-to-Agent) Integration: Architect Agent-to-Agent communication patterns that allow Amazon Connect AI agents to collaborate with specialized agents across the enterprise (e.g., billing agents, order management agents, IT support agents), enabling multi-agent workflows that span organizational boundaries.
* Integration Development: Build serverless integrations using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, and scripting (Python, Node.js) to connect Amazon Connect AI agents with customer data systems (CRMs, ERPs, databases, knowledge bases).
* Cloud Data Access: Architect secure access patterns to cloud-based data systems to power AI agent tool use and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
* Agentic IDE Proficiency: Leverage agentic development environments such as Kiro (and similar AI-assisted IDEs) to accelerate development workflows, including spec-driven development, agent hooks, MCP server configuration, and AI-assisted code generation.
* Pre-Production Validation: Guide customers through testing, evaluation, and validation of AI agent performance against defined success criteria before production deployment.
* Field Enablement: Share learnings, delivering technical deep-dives, and mentoring other SAs on agentic AI implementation patterns.

A day in the life
* Conducting data readiness assessments, identifying gaps in knowledge base coverage, and recommending data preparation steps before AI agent configuration
* Designing prompt strategies and evaluating model performance across different foundation models
* Building Lambda functions and API integrations that serve as tools for AI agents
* Configuring MCP servers to expose customer APIs, databases, and tools in a standardized format for agent consumption
* Designing A2A workflows where Amazon Connect agents hand off to or collaborate with specialized agents across the customer's enterprise
* Configuring knowledge bases and data connectors for RAG-powered agent responses
* Running evaluation frameworks to measure AI agent accuracy, latency, and customer satisfaction
* Conducting architecture reviews and providing prescriptive guidance for production readiness
* Documenting implementation patterns and contributing to the team's knowledge base

About the team
The Applied AI Solutions Architecture team is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). We are the technical bridge between Amazon Connect customers and the service teams building the next generation of AI-powered contact center capabilities. Our team operates at the forefront of agentic AI adoption, helping customers become production-ready with Amazon Connect's Unlimited AI features.

The Sustainability Engineering team is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to drive the definition, development, and continuous improvement of electrical infrastructure standards across Amazon facilities in Europe.

You will join a team which:
• Enables EV charging infrastructure implementation through electrical design definition and review
• Develops grid infrastructure standards spanning high-voltage up to 24 kV (HV) and low-voltage (LV) systems, ensuring a coordinated and resilient approach to grid design
• Explores emerging technologies to address evolving sustainability needs, with emphasis on smart grid integration, efficiency, and resilience
• Drives end-to-end deployment of EV chargers and other sustainability technologies across European sites
• Defines processes for procurement and maintenance of electrical and sustainability infrastructure
• Owns cost budgeting, forecasting, and tracking across sustainability programmes

Possible locations for this role: Luxembourg, London, Munich, Milan, Madrid, and Barcelona

Amazon is committed to building a sustainable future for our customers, local communities, and the planet. Under The Climate Pledge, we committed to achieving net-zero carbon across our business by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement. To get there, we need driven people who are dedicated to making a meaningful impact through sustainable energy technologies and scalable infrastructure design.

Key job responsibilities
• Own and develop electrical equipment standards, including standard designs for core electrical infrastructure in partnership with manufacturers and internal stakeholders
• Perform design validation and review to ensure compliance with established electrical standards during installation and commissioning of infrastructure
• Act as subject matter expert (SME) for LV and HV (up to 24kV) electrical systems
• Align stakeholder expectations and define technical requirements for EV charging network infrastructure and smart grid deployments
• Drive the technology roadmap for electrical infrastructure, including EV chargers, substations, energy efficiency solutions, and IoT technologies (e.g. smart metres)
• Develop business cases and present recommendations to leadership to secure approval for programme scoping and investment decisions
• Coordinate with programme managers to ensure quality and standards compliance across large-scale installations
• Drive process improvement across commissioning, audit, value engineering, and cost control activities


A day in the life
Your day could include engagement with all levels of the organisation and multiple stakeholder groups to drive short-, mid-, and long-term technical decisions with large-scale impact across the Amazon network. You will also work with partners from Operations, Reliability & Maintenance, Health and Safety, Global Fleet Product, Finance, Procurement, and external vendors to design and deploy electrical infrastructure across Amazon’s operational sites in Europe.

About the team
The Sustainability Engineering team drives the execution and deployment of EV charging infrastructure, grid connections, and smart grid solutions across Amazon’s European sites. We manage supply chain, procurement, and maintenance activities, and define the processes that ensure consistent, scalable delivery. To enable this, the team develops and continuously improves electrical standards and technologies that underpin reliable, compliant deployment at pace. We power Amazon’s sustainable growth through operational excellence and continuous innovation.

This role is responsible for developing the strategy and execution of marketing initiatives across retailer, distributor, and other partner channels in the region. A successful candidate will be comfortable with ambiguity and energised by the opportunity to build something from scratch while also delivering tangible results at pace. We are looking for someone who can execute at both a strategic and tactical level, equally at home presenting a channel strategy to senior leadership and managing the workback schedule for an in-store launch across multiple markets.

You will own the development of B2C partner marketing strategy end-to-end: from building frameworks and processes that do not yet exist, to working hand-in-hand with partners to drive measurable subscriber growth. This is a greenfield opportunity to lead marketing collaboration with strategic partners in on of Amazon’s most ambitious new ventures.

The role requires close collaboration with senior stakeholders across the Leo organisation, including Consumer business leadership, B2B Partner Marketing, Product Marketing, Brand, Business Development, and regional commercial teams.

Operating across multiple European markets, you will navigate different regulatory environments, cultural nuances, languages, and retail landscapes. You will build and manage relationships with major international and local retail and distribution partners, adapting global strategies to resonate in each market while maintaining brand consistency.

This position may require access to information, technology, or hardware that is subject to export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment in this position is contingent upon obtaining any required export licenses or other approvals from the United States government. As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations.


Key job responsibilities
• Define and own the indirect partner and channel marketing strategy for Amazon Leo B2C across European markets — building frameworks, processes, and measurement approaches from the ground up.
• Lead senior-level distributor and retailer partner engagements and support quarterly business reviews.
• Work at the strategic level (generating bold and innovative ideas for growth and scale) and at the tactical level (managing marketing campaign execution, planning in-store fixtures, and solving problems).
• Influence and align cross-functional stakeholders across Leo, working with Brand, Legal, Finance, and regional commercial teams to unlock partner marketing opportunities and resolve blockers.
• Manage marketing initiatives with retail, distributor, and third-party sales partners, including co-branded campaigns and activations adapted for local markets.
• Own in-store and online retail execution with channel partners, creating best-in-class customer experiences tailored to each market’s retail environment.
• Work closely with agencies across multiple markets to brief, execute, and sign off in-store and digital merchandising collateral, setting workbacks, approving creative, and ensuring compliance with global brand guidelines while allowing for local adaptation.
• Manage simultaneous time-sensitive projects spanning multiple countries, languages, and timezones - driving execution end-to-end in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with competing priorities.

About the team
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organisations operating in locations without reliable, high-speed connectivity.

The right candidate leads with clarity and empathy, inspires others, and has a passion for solving problems at massive scale. You excel through innovation, creativity, and attention to detail. You will have autonomy and ownership while contributing to the supportive culture on the team. excluded_nonbusiness_jobs.description:
Amazon opened its virtual doors in 1995 and strives to be the world's most customer-centric company. The goal of Amazon Logistics is to build a world class last mile operation, ensuring that orders are delivered quickly, accurately, and cost effectively.

The LATAM Engineering team is seeking an experienced, hands-on and customer obsessed Senior Process Engineer to own equipment development and standardization across our Last Mile delivery network. Sitting centrally in London, you will define and maintain equipment standards for Carts, Racks, Bags, Automation and MHE, driving parity across LATAM while acting as the bridge to WW engineering teams and other regions. Equipment you develop will always meet safety, customer experience, capacity, quality and cost goals. You will lead design, qualification and value engineering initiatives, partnering with country engineering teams, Operations, Safety and vendors. You will also work closely with your WW counterparts to benchmark performance and align on global standards.

This position requires strong leadership, deep customer focus, strong autonomy and exceptional project management skills. It will involve regular communication with executors and project sponsors at both the country and WW level, and requires you to be detail-oriented and comfortable partnering across functional business and technical teams. To be successful in this role, you need to pair strong analytical skills and a data-driven outlook with strong intuition.

This role will be based out of London and may involve occasional travel within Emerging Countries.

Key job responsibilities
As the central Equipment/Product Strategic Engineer for LATAM, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of process equipment standards — from concept and design through qualification and network-wide deployment. You will be the bridge between LATAM and WW teams, ensuring equipment parity and raising the bar across regions.

- Define, develop, and maintain equipment standards for Carts, Racks, Bags, Automation, and MHE across the LATAM Delivery Station network
- Lead equipment design, qualification, and value engineering initiatives to meet safety, capacity, quality, and cost targets
- Benchmark equipment performance across regions and drive parity by partnering with WW Process Engineering counterparts (EU, NA, AMET, JP)
- Develop technical specifications, qualification criteria, and design documentation for network-wide adoption
- Partner with Operations, Safety, Launch & Expansion, and vendor teams to ensure equipment solutions meet local and global requirements
- Support concurrent equipment development projects, managing priorities across multiple countries and timelines
- Conduct data-driven analysis to identify improvement opportunities and inform equipment investment decisions

A day in the life
You'll start your day reviewing equipment performance data and project updates from LATAM country teams. You'll lead cross-functional discussions with WW counterparts to align on equipment standards and close parity gaps. Expect to evaluate vendor proposals, refine technical specifications, and conduct value engineering reviews. Your stakeholders range from field operations leaders to senior engineering leadership across regions. You'll balance strategic standardization work with hands-on problem solving — ensuring the equipment our associates use every day is safe, efficient, and world-class.

About the team
The LATAM team partners closely with AMZL Operations and support functions to identify, design and develop best-in-class process infrastructure and process layouts, and to deliver them as AMZL network standard infrastructure. To enable this, the team supports prioritization of regional and WW continuous improvement initiatives in addition to cross-regional benchmarking.

excluded_nonbusiness_jobs.description:
Trusted by more startups around the world, AWS makes the power of cloud computing accessible for all by giving founders everywhere access to the same technology that powers the world’s largest companies. With nearly 20 years of experience gained from supporting hundreds of thousands of startups that have come before, we help founders prove that their world-changing ideas are possible, at any stage of growth or level of funding. This is why more startups, and over 80% of unicorns, build on AWS.

Startup Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with startups of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.

In this role you will get to practice your creativity, linking technology to tangible solutions and educating AWS customers about the art of the possible. You will have the opportunity to produce cloud-native reference architectures for a variety of use cases. You will have the support to grow your expertise in industry and technology areas of depth. Every day you will be learning something new from your customers, your peers and your own experiments.

You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to Startups, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS. Startups follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

Key job responsibilities
• As a Solutions Architect, you will work directly with customers to accelerate their projects and recommend best-practice architectures in line with their long-term business outcomes.
• You operate as a trusted advisor for startups. The best interests of the customer will shape the guidance you provide. You work backwards from their priorities and find inventive ways to add value with solutions utilizing AWS and its Partners’ technology.
• You capture and share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for AWS. You use your customer understanding to participate the creation or updates of technical content and reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts).
• Evangelize and educate about AWS technology (e.g. workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of modern AI/ML frameworks, large language models (LLMs), foundation models, and GenAI application architectures. While hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions is highly preferred, we also value candidates who bring strategic expertise in AI/ML solution design, model selection, prompt engineering, and responsible AI practices. You should be comfortable discussing topics ranging from model fine-tuning and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures to AI governance, cost optimization for AI workloads, and emerging trends in generative AI. Your ability to translate complex AI/ML concepts into practical solutions for startup customers will be essential to helping them innovate quickly and scale effectively.

To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about startups and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives. You are a lifetime learner that develops areas of depth in technical domains relevant to your interests and your customer's outcomes. You are prepared to work in a fast-paced environment, where you will be positively challenged and consistently embrace the Amazon Culture.

A day in the life
The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly-scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.

About the team
The startup organization at AWS comprises experts from across the global ecosystem, including former founders and CTOs, venture capitalists, angel investors, and mentors who upskill today's founders to navigate challenges and opportunities as they build their business, and our Startup Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to working with startup companies as they build and scale their businesses. We’re here to make sure that they can deploy the best, most scalable, and most secure architectures possible – and that they spend as little time and money as possible doing so. We are a group of technologists with varied backgrounds; from fresh graduates to ex-CTOs, all growing our skills and startup expertise, while working on cutting edge technology use-cases with some of the world’s most innovative companies.

About AWS:

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Amazon's grocery business is scaling rapidly across Europe — and the perishable supply chain that supports it needs to scale with it. We are looking for a strategic Supply Chain Manager to own the long-term network plan for EU perishable distribution, defining how perishable product reaches customers across international markets.

This role sits within the Perishable Distribution Strategy team in WW Grocery Supply Chain and Tech (WWGST). You will build the multi-year roadmap for EU perishable infrastructure — from DC placement and capacity phasing through sourcing topology and last-mile delivery design. You will work at the intersection of network planning, finance, technology, and retail to translate demand signals into investment decisions.

This is a builder role. The international perishable strategy is in early development — you will create it.

Key job responsibilities
Own the international perishable distribution strategy end-to-end — from problem definition through leadership alignment and execution planning
Build complex network models to evaluate topology options, capacity timing, and CapEx trade-offs across multiple international markets
Partner with NA program owners to determine which capabilities transfer to international and which require local adaptation
Drive goal alignment with technology teams to secure engineering resources for international programs
Develop and present strategy documents to VP-level leadership, translating ambiguous opportunities into clear investment decisions
Work autonomously across time zones and organizations to understand local market constraints, regulatory requirements, and banner-specific needs
Identify and mitigate risks proactively — particularly around resourcing windows, technology dependencies, and timeline misalignment between regions

A day in the life
You will spend your time building financial models that inform where and when to invest in international perishable capacity, writing strategy docs that align senior leadership across multiple organizations, and partnering with local teams to turn demand forecasts into network plans. Your stakeholders span NA supply chain (who built the capabilities you're adapting), international retail (who define the customer requirements), local supply chain execution teams, and technology teams (who build the systems). You will operate with significant autonomy in a space where the frameworks and processes are being built for the first time.

About the team
The Perishable Distribution Strategy team owns long-range planning for Amazon's perishable supply chain — the network of temperature-controlled distribution centers, consolidation hubs, and delivery infrastructure that gets fresh product to customers. We define where to build, what to build, and when — balancing customer experience, cost efficiency, and speed of execution. Our work directly shapes the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's grocery businesses globally.

As a System Development Engineer you will help to deploy, manage, fix and reinvent the software tools, services and components that network engineering rely on to automate our network and keep it operational. You will actively be involved in innovating new software solutions to solve the challenges of operating the AWS network. Your internal customers are your network engineer colleagues, and through close collaboration, support and exchange of ideas, we share a common goal to serve our external customers and grow through learning and innovation.

A SysDE is responsible for maintaining and improving their team's services end-to-end, requiring them to troubleshoot and identify the root cause of issues that arise within their systems. We design and implement automation and new software solutions to improve operational efficiency on behalf of our Network Engineer customers. We're at the forefront of powering AWS's vast network infrastructure, transforming complex operational challenges into scalable systems that enhance the reliability and efficiency of one of the world's largest cloud networks.

Amazon Web Services is one of the fastest-growing businesses within Amazon, continually expanding its product offerings and geographic footprint across EMEA. We're looking for a Tax Manager to join our EMEA Tax Department in London and provide corporation tax advisory support to the AWS cloud computing business.

This is a broad advisory role with genuine variety — you'll work across multiple jurisdictions, navigate the intersection of corporate tax with withholding, indirect, transfer pricing and other tax disciplines, and partner closely with both the tax team and the wider AWS business. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy while remaining well-connected to a collaborative, knowledgeable team. There's also scope to get involved in ad-hoc enquiries and support during audits.

At Amazon, we believe that in-person collaboration is essential to our culture and innovation. While we allow flexibility for personal circumstances, we generally expect employees to work from our offices five days a week. This approach has consistently shown that spontaneous interactions, rapid problem-solving, and the energy of in-person teamwork lead to better results for our customers. In particular, our data shows that teams working together in person are more effective at making complex decisions, onboarding new team members, and fostering the kind of creative collaboration that has driven Amazon's success. The serendipitous hallway conversations and impromptu whiteboarding sessions that happen naturally in an office environment have proven invaluable to our invention process and maintaining our high bar for excellence.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and coordinate tax requirements for country expansions and new programme launches across EMEA.
- Provide practical, clear tax guidance to the business — building relationships that ensure ongoing adherence.
- Support ad-hoc projects such as restructurings or transactions involving the AWS business.
- Research international tax issues and work with external advisers where needed to support business initiatives.
- Engage with outside tax advisors to deliver on tax projects.

About the team
AWS offers a broad set of global cloud-based products including compute, storage, databases, analytics, networking, mobile, developer tools, management tools, Internet of Things, security and enterprise applications. These services help organisations move faster, lower IT costs, and scale. AWS is trusted by the largest enterprises and the hottest start-ups to power a wide variety of workloads including: web and mobile applications, game development, data processing and warehousing, storage, archive, and many others.

In addition, AWS offers a variety of support services to help customers in deploying AWS services, as well as a comprehensive training and certification programme. Finally, AWS also offers a Marketplace, enabling customers to locate, buy and immediately use digital products sold by third-party sellers.

Build and maintain a domain-specific pattern library extending the corporate design system with reusable components

Conduct user research (shadows, interviews, usability tests) to validate decisions and surface unmet needs

Contribute to cross-team experience strategy, information architecture, and long-term vision for a unified product suite

Collaborate daily with product managers, engineers, and data scientists to translate complex business requirements into clear, intuitive experiences

A day in the life
Your primary focus is shaping the end-to-end user experience for internal tools that support strategic planning and investment decisions. You'll partner closely with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate complex workflows into intuitive, scalable designs. You'll join a small, high-impact design team embedded within an organization of 200+ teammates managing 100+ enterprise technology products. These products enable teams worldwide to plan, deliver, and operate a global network of 5,500+ physical sites across 50 countries. Our UX practice is in its first year. excluded_nonbusiness_jobs.description:
Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video, one of the world's leading streaming services, delivers premium content to millions of viewers worldwide. This includes acclaimed Amazon MGM Originals such as The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power, Fallout and Project Hail Mary.

Amazon MGM Studios, the production and development arm of Amazon, creates content exclusively for Prime Video customers globally. We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented VFX Manager to join our team in the UK and support the ambitious slate of International Originals. This key role will manage VFX workflows from development through delivery, supporting VFX budgets, schedules, planning, and production partner relationships. The role involves close collaboration with internal teams including Production, Post-Production, Business Affairs, Creative, and Development, as well as our production partners and third party vendors.

The ideal candidate will bring solid experience in VFX production, combining skills as a VFX Producer or VFX Manager, with a comprehensive understanding of the scripted TV and film landscape. We're looking for someone with strong organizational and interpersonal skills who is building industry relationships.

This position requires a dynamic, self-motivated individual who can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. The successful applicant will support numerous projects in various stages of development, production, and post-production, while engaging frequently with industry professionals. This role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the future of UK and European content on a global streaming platform.


Key job responsibilities
Manage VFX needs across a selected slate of UK and European Scripted Series and Movies, reporting to the Head of VFX, International, in line with Amazon MGM's International Originals priorities
Support the greenlight process for VFX through collaboration with production, creative, post, business affairs, and finance teams
Develop internal VFX assessments and breakdowns from creative materials, scripts, storyboards, and pre-vis
Support Production Companies in planning for VFX by providing management and guidance on methodology, breakdowns, budgets, talent and schedules
Build and maintain relationships with leading VFX vendors and talent, supporting key negotiations and partnerships
Assist in the development and maintenance of department databases to track all aspects of project management, vendor capabilities, talent availability pools, and resource allocation.
Oversee vendor selection, bid evaluation, and work allocation processes for assigned projects
Recommend vendors for assigned projects and manage vendor issues, developing solutions to address them
Support VFX budget tracking, schedules, deliverables, and status reporting with production companies
Review VFX deliverables to ensure quality standards are met
Identify and resolve production challenges while maintaining creative integrity and keeping to budget
Coordinate with internal teams for marketing, promotional, and publicity needs
Establish efficient workflow processes between creative, production, and post-production departments
Manage internal and external show data through studio-based databases and internal communication tools to minimize disruption and meet delivery targets
Take ownership of smaller to mid-sized shows with little to no oversight, covering all aspects of VFX production from project inception through delivery
Act as the main point of contact with Production Companies on assigned projects, managing administrative duties, VFX workflows, and coordination including VFX assessments, breakdowns, vendor and talent selection, advising on contracts, payment schedules, and ProdCo management and reporting through all phases of production
Facilitate progress, identify blockers, and increase the visibility of issues, providing improvement recommendations that enhance project efficiency and effectiveness
Optimise procedures, processes, and best practices at the production level
Model Amazon's culture and values, serving as an ambassador for the VFX team and wider business

excluded_nonbusiness_jobs.description:
The Brand Innovation Lab team at Amazon advertising is seeking a talented and passionate Visual Designer to create innovative, visually stunning and effective advertising experiences that tell stories and drive business performance for the world’s leading brands across Europe. The ideal candidate will combine visual design craft with a growing understanding of UX/UI principles and an introduction to web build execution in Webflow. Working within a defined creative strategy, you will contribute to campaign ideation and design, delivering functional, customer-centred experiences that drive business performance across Amazon's advertising platforms. You work under the guidance of Senior Creatives, with review of your output, progressing toward greater independence as your skills develop.



Key job responsibilities
- Design advertising experiences for leading global brands, executing campaign creative tasks within a defined creative strategy. Your primary focus will be display and web experiences, with exposure to video and interactive formats growing over time.
- Contribute to campaign ideation by partnering with senior creatives to bring ideas to life through high-fidelity concepts, wireframes, and visual designs that integrate marketing objectives, target audience, creative assets, and Amazon design patterns.
- Learn to build responsive web experiences in Webflow with guidance from senior creatives, progressing from simple components toward full page builds as your skills develop.
- Apply and develop your understanding of UX/UI principles in your work, learning how advertising experiences are made intuitive, accessible, and optimised for customer engagement.
- Create user-centred, on-brand design solutions that meet measurable business goals and project requirements within defined creative parameters.
- Collaborate with your peers and cross-functional partners to deliver assigned tasks on time and to a high standard.
- Contribute to pitch decks by creating high-fidelity visual concepts that communicate creative ideas to advertisers and agency partners.
- Over time, contribute to shared design component libraries in Figma and Webflow, and to cross-platform rich media specifications.
- Participate in design reviews, critiques, and brainstorm sessions as a tactical contributor, giving and receiving constructive feedback.
- Actively seek to grow your knowledge of design trends, UX best practices, web technologies, and Amazon's advertising ecosystem, applying what you learn to your creative output.
- Support production design tasks including asset resizing, adaptation, and quality assurance across deliverables.
- Prioritise your own work queue and escalate roadblocks or risks early when deadlines are tight.

About the team
The Brand Innovation Lab is Amazon' Ads Innovation team dedicated to creating one-of-a-kind campaigns and activations for global advertisers.

Leveraging the full Amazon canvas: custom landing pages, Alexa, Fire TV, Twitch, Prime Video, and more. We build campaigns that reach millions of customers across digital channels and in the real world.

The team works specifically on Prime Video IP and brands, developing co-branded full-funnel campaigns.

excluded_nonbusiness_jobs.description:
Amazon's Brand Innovation Lab is looking for a skilled, customer-obsessed Visual Designer to craft brand-focused digital and visual experiences across Amazon's owned properties, devices, and external platforms.

As a Visual Designer, you will develop visual campaign concepts and assets, and create exceptional UX/UI web experiences for the world's leading advertisers — applying rigorous design craft across the full customer journey.

You are both imaginative and pragmatic, feeling comfortable delivering exceptional creatives in a fast-paced environment. You will collaborate with internal and external partners and stakeholders to integrate top standard craft and costumer experience into sponsorships offering. You are proactive and solution oriented with proven experience in moving projects from concept into successful execution. You identify design workflow gaps and turn them into scalable, repeatable visual solutions. You’ve proven you start with the customer and work backwards, understanding that what you do is critical to creating a successful, consistent shopping experience. You make sure the creative and craft bar is always high in every detail of the project, for both you and your team, and looking around corners to take every opportunity you get to raise the bar even higher. As a candidate, you will have a deep understanding of visual design, ideation, and UX/UI processes and software. An online portfolio and solid design experience are required.

Key job responsibilities
- Design creative executions across Amazon-owned devices, brand placements, and ad formats, maintaining high productivity, quality standards, and turnaround targets.
- Create innovative UX/UI designs for web using industry-standard tools, including Figma and Webflow.
- Develop and optimise visual assets for advertisers' campaigns across Amazon's platforms — web, mobile, large screen, and emerging devices.
- Own the design and visual storytelling of high-impact presentations.
- Design customer-centred campaigns across Amazon's platforms.
- Lead campaign executions in close collaboration with EU and US design teams.
- Ensure quality control in partnership with marketing stakeholders, design peers, and quality specialists.
- Follow creative direction with precision while actively contributing to pushing the creative envelope — always with the customer at the centre.
- Serve as a subject-matter expert in one or more design disciplines, supporting teams, solving creative challenges, and mentoring emerging designers.
- Apply analytical and strategic thinking to design decisions.
- Manage multiple partners and stakeholders effectively, communicating with clarity to drive projects and campaigns forward.

A day in the life
- Execute best-in-class brand experiences across the Amazon canvas.
- Design and develop interactive customer experiences across web, app, and emerging touchpoints, optimised for mobile, desktop, and large-screen environments.
- Develop high-quality visual assets that bring advertiser campaigns to life across Amazon's ecosystem.
- Create compelling pitch decks, mock-ups, and interactive prototypes.
- Partner closely with internal and external collaborators to present, review, and evolve creative work.
- Lead campaign executions end to end in collaboration with the wider EU creative team.
- Work alongside Art and Creative Directors to explore and elevate design craft.

About the team
The Brand Innovation Lab is Amazon's internal team dedicated to creating one-of-a-kind campaigns and activations for global advertisers — from Universal and LEGO to automotive, hospitality, and beyond.

Leveraging the full Amazon canvas — custom landing pages, Alexa, Twitch, Prime Video, and more — we build campaigns that reach millions of customers across digital channels and in the real world.

The Non-Endemic pod works specifically with brands that do not sell directly on Amazon (with the exception of Toys and Video Games), spanning entertainment, travel, quick-service restaurants, automotive, insurance, telecoms, and more.
